items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。
英鎊兌美元升值0.05%，至1.3401美元。
澳幣兌美元則下跌0.11%，至0.7019美元。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 美媒爆川普致電馬斯克 要求解除烏克蘭星鏈限速
items.title_en: U.S. Media Reports Trump Called Musk to Request Lifting Speed Limit on Ukraine’s Starlink
paras: 《華爾街日報》週四 (22 日) 引述美國官員報導，美國總統川普週三 (21 日) 致電 SpaceX 執行長馬斯克，要求解除對烏克蘭軍用版星鏈 (Starlink) 的限速措施。美烏官員表示，通話後，系統運作已於週四改善，但尚未完全恢復正常。
該報引述知情官員透露，川普在通話中對系統仍設有每小時約 100 英里 (約 161 公里) 的移動速度上限表達不滿。這項限制使部分烏克蘭攻擊無人機及攔截無人機在高速飛行時，無法持續連上衛星網路，削弱烏軍打擊目標及抵禦俄軍攻勢的能力。
報導指出，川普本週已向幕僚及盟友表示，希望撤銷限速措施。部分烏方官員指出，目前設備已能在超過先前速度上限的情況下維持連線，但系統功能仍未完全恢復。
川普稍晚被問及是否曾致電馬斯克時，未正面證實，僅表示：「不管是我打的，還是其他人打的 (電話)，都沒有差別，重點是他已經恢復服務了。」他當時正離開白宮，準備前往愛荷華州參加競選造勢活動。
隨著連線狀況改善，限速決策的責任歸屬仍有待釐清。
白宮援引川普近期說法，重申川普否認要求馬斯克限速，也不知道由誰下令。
《華爾街日報》先前報導，馬斯克曾下令對烏克蘭使用的軍用版星鏈實施限速，但 SpaceX 與白宮對於他是自行決定，還是應政府要求採取行動，說法並不一致。川普則多次否認曾下令限速，也表示不知道是誰下達指令。
美國政府高層對馬斯克在此事中的角色，也有不同表態。
副總統范斯週四向記者表示，馬斯克不希望在缺乏美國政府明確指引的情況下捲入戰爭，是完全可以理解的。他認為，問題的核心在於美國對烏克蘭與俄羅斯的政策方向。
國防部長赫格塞斯與國務卿盧比歐先前則表示，馬斯克有權依據公司服務條款採取行動，無須政府介入。赫格塞斯本週稍早指出，使用者必須遵守服務條款，星鏈可據此做出相關決定。
限速措施實施前幾天，川普與馬斯克均曾公開批評烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基攻擊俄羅斯柴油煉油廠，川普並將能源價格上漲歸咎於這些攻擊。星鏈連線問題也使美烏關係降至數月來低點。
這起事件也引發國會關注。跨黨派參議員 15 日已聯名要求國防部監察長調查星盾服務中斷，釐清美國官員是否批准或事先知情。
美國民主黨籍參議員Richard Blumenthal 週四宣布展開調查，將釐清烏克蘭星鏈服務為何在未事先通知的情況下遭到限制，並檢視五角大廈依賴 SpaceX 提供關鍵衛星通訊所帶來的影響。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that, citing U.S. officials, President Donald Trump called SpaceX CEO Elon Musk on Wednesday (the 21st) and asked to lift the speed‑limit imposed on the military‑grade Starlink used by Ukraine. Ukrainian and U.S. officials said the system’s performance improved on Thursday after the call, but it has not fully returned to normal.

The paper quoted informed officials who said Trump expressed dissatisfaction that the system still had a movement‑speed cap of about 100 miles per hour (roughly 161 km/h). The limit prevented some Ukrainian attack drones and interceptor drones from staying connected to the satellite network during high‑speed flight, weakening the Ukrainian forces’ ability to strike targets and repel Russian offensives.

The report noted that Trump has told his staff and allies this week that he wants the speed‑limit removed. Some Ukrainian officials said the equipment can now stay connected even when exceeding the previous speed cap, but the system’s functionality has not been completely restored.

When later asked whether he had indeed called Musk, Trump did not give a direct confirmation, saying only, “It doesn’t matter who made the call, the point is the service has been restored.” He made the remark as he was leaving the White House to head to Iowa for a campaign rally.
With the connection situation improving, the responsibility for the speed‑limit decision remains to be clarified.
The White House, citing Trump’s recent statements, reiterated that Trump denies ordering Musk to impose a speed limit and says he does not know who gave the order.

The Wall Street Journal previously reported that Musk had ordered a speed‑limit on the military‑grade Starlink used by Ukraine, but SpaceX and the White House gave conflicting accounts on whether he acted on his own or at government request. Trump has repeatedly denied issuing such an order and says he does not know who did.
Senior U.S. officials have also offered differing statements about Musk’s role in the matter.

Vice President Kamala Harris told reporters on Thursday that it is understandable that Musk does not want to become embroiled in a war without clear guidance from the U.S. government. She said the core issue is the United States’ policy direction toward Ukraine and Russia.

Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin and Secretary of State Antony Blinken earlier said Musk is free to act under his company’s service terms and does not need government intervention. Austin earlier this week emphasized that users must comply with the service terms, and Starlink can make decisions accordingly.

In the days before the speed‑limit was imposed, both Trump and Musk publicly criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky’s attacks on Russian diesel refineries, with Trump blaming rising energy prices on those attacks. The Starlink connectivity issue also pushed U.S.–Ukraine relations to a low point not seen in months.

The episode has drawn congressional attention. On the 15th, a bipartisan group of senators jointly urged the Department of Defense’s inspector general to investigate the Starshield service disruption and determine whether U.S. officials approved or were aware of it beforehand.

Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal announced on Thursday that he will launch an investigation to find out why Ukraine’s Starlink service was restricted without prior notice and to examine the Pentagon’s reliance on SpaceX for critical satellite communications.

items.title: Meta崩跌近7% 自由現金流轉負、CDS利差升至歷史新高
items.title_en: Meta crashes nearly 7% as free cash flow turns negative, CDS spread hits historic high
paras: Meta (META-US) 週四 (22 日) 股價重挫近 7% 至每股 648.85 美元。儘管第 3 季營收優於市場預期，但自由現金流轉負，加上公司上調全年資本支出預估下限，引發投資人對人工智慧 (AI) 投資規模與資金需求的擔憂。
《CNBC》報導，Meta 的 5 年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差週四升至歷史新高，顯示隨著公司持續擴大 AI 支出，投資人對其信用風險的疑慮升溫。CDS 是用於對沖債務違約風險的金融工具，利差擴大通常反映信用保障成本上升。
Meta 預估，全年資本支出將介於 1,350 億至 1,450 億美元，將原先 1,300 億美元的區間下限提高 50 億美元，上限則維持不變。
公司第 3 季自由現金流為負 21.2 億美元，龐大投資對現金流的壓力成為市場關注焦點。
相較之下，核心業務營收仍維持成長。Meta 第 3 季營收年增 26%，達 646 億美元，高於分析師預估的 633.7 億美元。每股盈餘為 3.83 美元，但分析指出，尚不清楚這項數字能否直接與華爾街預估的 5.75 美元相比。
除了支出與現金流，Meta 週三公布財報時也揭露，將設立不具投票權的 C 類普通股，藉此維持「創辦人主導」的治理架構，並提高公司為未來成長籌資的彈性。
根據提交美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 的文件，若「加州財富稅」通過，執行長祖克柏可能因持有 Meta 股票，面臨數十億美元的稅款，並可能因此遷離加州。文件指出，新的股票方案促使祖克柏決定留在加州。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) saw its stock plunge almost 7% on Thursday (the 22nd) to $648.85 per share. Although third‑quarter revenue beat market expectations, free cash flow turned negative and the company raised the lower bound of its full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook, sparking investor worries about the scale and funding needs of its artificial‑intelligence investments.

CNBC reported that Meta’s five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) spread jumped to a historic high on Thursday, indicating that as the company continues to ramp up AI spending, investors’ concerns about its credit risk are intensifying. A CDS is a financial instrument used to hedge debt‑default risk, and a widening spread typically reflects higher costs for credit protection.

Meta now expects full‑year capital expenditures to be between $135 billion and $145 billion, lifting the lower end of the prior $130 billion range by $5 billion while keeping the upper limit unchanged.
The company posted a negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion for the third quarter, and the heavy investment pressure on cash flow has become a focal point for the market.

By contrast, core‑business revenue continued to grow. Meta’s third‑quarter revenue rose 26% year‑over‑year to $64.6 billion, beating analysts’ estimate of $63.37 billion. Earnings per share were $3.83, though analysts noted it is unclear how this figure compares directly with Wall Street’s forecast of $5.75 per share.

In addition to spending and cash‑flow issues, Meta disclosed on Wednesday that it will create a non‑voting Class C common‑stock series to preserve a “founder‑led” governance structure and increase the company’s flexibility to raise capital for future growth.

According to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), if a “California wealth tax” is enacted, CEO Mark Zuckerberg could face billions of dollars in taxes on his Meta holdings and might consider leaving California. The filing noted that the new stock plan is intended to encourage Zuckerberg to stay in the state.

items.title: 不只AI借錢讓人怕！法國公債也拉警報 信用市場怎麼了？
items.title_en: Not Just AI Borrowing That Scares People! French Government Bonds Also Sound the Alarm – What’s Happening in the Credit Market?
paras: 從舉債興建資料中心的AI業者，到背負龐大債務的法國政府，信用市場正陸續亮起警訊。投資人對大規模借款與未來償債能力愈來愈謹慎，推升企業及政府的債務違約保障成本，也顯示這波壓力可能不只侷限於AI產業。
根據《CNBC》分析FactSet數據，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)、軟銀集團(9984-JP)，以及法國、義大利的五年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差均已擴大。CDS可用於對沖債務違約風險，利差上升代表保障成本增加，也反映市場要求更高的風險溢價。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳周四表示，新型雲端業者需求雖然「強勁到爆表」，但資金供給遠遠追不上需求。他認為問題最終會獲得解決，但這番話也凸顯AI基礎設施擴張正面臨融資瓶頸。

AI擴張仰賴舉債 違約保障成本攀升

CoreWeave是這波信用風險重新定價中最受關注的業者之一。截至10月21日，其五年期CDS利差升至1,065.84個基點，反映市場對這家高度仰賴負債的公司能否持續籌資擴張，抱持更大疑慮。
甲骨文同日的CDS利差達308.25個基點，高於1月2日的141個基點。標普全球評級已於7月將甲骨文信用評等調降至投資等級最低一級，理由是基礎設施業務擴張提高了整體信用風險。
軟銀則是OpenAI的重要投資人，也投入資料中心與電力基礎設施，包括承諾在法國投資870億美元興建資料中心。其五年期CDS利差於10月20日達432個基點，接近四年高點，高於1月5日的284個基點。
FedWatch Advisors創辦人暨投資長Ben Emons指出，市場可能不再願意輕易為巨額資本支出、高槓桿與不確定的未來現金流提供資金。同樣的態度轉變，也正在推高法國政府的融資風險溢價。

法國債務保障成本超越義大利 財政與政治壓力交織

法國尚未陷入全面債務危機，但市場不安已明顯升高。近期大規模抗議與暴動，加上預算不確定性及沉重債務，進一步加劇投資人疑慮。
法國五年期CDS利差從1月2日的29.74個基點，升至10月21日的89.8個基點，已高於義大利。義大利同類利差也從年初的28.33個基點，升至10月22日的67.1個基點。
相較之下，德國CDS利差雖也由年初的7.47個基點升至12.15個基點，但仍明顯低於法國與義大利，反映各國信用風險的差距。
麥格理集團全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，法國政府債務相當於國內生產毛額(GDP)的120%，且遲遲無法降低赤字，是違約保障成本攀升的主要原因；德國政府債務占GDP比重則為65%。
法國10年期公債殖利率也突破5%，為2002年以來首見，與德國同年期公債的利差擴大至約1.6個百分點。這代表投資人要求額外報酬，才願意持有法債。不過，這項差距仍低於2010年代初期歐債危機時的極端水準。
法國還將面臨信評考驗，穆迪預定於10月23日檢視其Aa3主權評等，目前展望為負向。政治分歧持續阻礙財政整頓，也使這次評估格外受到關注。

信用壓力不只AI 高收益債風險溢價同步上升

市場也擔心，科技巨頭的AI相關債務負擔可能比外界掌握的更大。標普全球10月19日警告，大型雲端業者實際承擔的AI相關債務風險，可能高於市場目前認知。
更廣泛的信用指標也出現變化。根據LSEG數據，追蹤北美投機等級企業信用風險的CDX高收益債指數，其五年期利差中間報價於10月20日達355.35個基點，較2025年底擴大約39個基點。
這顯示投資人要求更高風險溢價的趨勢，已不只出現在AI相關借款人身上。企業擴張能否帶來足夠現金流，以及政府能否控制赤字，正同時受到信用市場更嚴格的檢驗。
paras_en: From AI firms that are borrowing to build data centers to the heavily indebted French government, warning signs are lighting up across the credit market. Investors are becoming increasingly cautious about large‑scale borrowing and future repayment ability, pushing up the cost of debt‑default protection for corporations and governments and showing that this pressure may not be limited to the AI sector.

According to CNBC’s analysis of FactSet data, the five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) spreads for CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Oracle (ORCL‑US), SoftBank Group (9984‑JP) and for France and Italy have all widened. CDS contracts are used to hedge debt‑default risk, and a higher spread means higher protection costs and reflects the market’s demand for a larger risk premium.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday that demand from new cloud providers is "off the charts," but funding is far lagging behind that demand. He believes the problem will eventually be solved, but his comments highlight that AI infrastructure expansion is hitting a financing bottleneck.

AI expansion relies on borrowing, and default‑protection costs are climbing. CoreWeave is one of the most closely watched companies in this wave of credit‑risk repricing. As of October 21, its five‑year CDS spread rose to 1,065.84 basis points, reflecting heightened market doubts about the heavily leveraged firm’s ability to keep raising capital for expansion.

Oracle’s CDS spread hit 308.25 basis points on the same day, up from 141 basis points on January 2. S&P Global downgraded Oracle’s credit rating to the lowest tier of investment grade in July, citing that its infrastructure‑business expansion has raised its overall credit risk.

SoftBank, a major investor in OpenAI, is also pouring money into data‑center and power‑infrastructure projects, including a pledged $87 billion investment in French data centers. Its five‑year CDS spread reached 432 basis points on October 20, near a four‑year high and above the 284 basis points recorded on January 5.

Ben Emons, founder and CIO of FedWatch Advisors, noted that the market may no longer be willing to easily fund massive capital expenditures, high leverage and uncertain future cash flows. The same shift in attitude is also pushing up the financing risk premium for the French government.

France has not fallen into a full‑blown debt crisis, but market anxiety has risen sharply. Recent large‑scale protests and riots, combined with budget uncertainty and heavy debt, have further heightened investor concerns.

France’s five‑year CDS spread climbed from 29.74 basis points on January 2 to 89.8 basis points on October 21, overtaking Italy. Italy’s comparable spread rose from 28.33 basis points at the start of the year to 67.1 basis points on October 22.

By contrast, Germany’s CDS spread also rose from 7.47 basis points at the beginning of the year to 12.15 basis points, but remains clearly lower than France’s and Italy’s, reflecting the gap in sovereign credit risk across the countries.

Macquarie Group’s global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said France’s government debt equals 120% of GDP and the persistent inability to cut the deficit is the main driver of rising default‑protection costs; Germany’s debt‑to‑GDP ratio is about 65%.

France’s 10‑year government bond yield also broke past 5% – a first since 2002 – and the spread over Germany’s comparable bond widened to roughly 1.6 percentage points. This indicates investors demand extra compensation to hold French bonds, though the gap is still below the extreme levels seen in the early 2010s Euro‑debt crisis.

France will also face a credit‑rating test, as Moody’s is scheduled to review its Aa3 sovereign rating on October 23, currently with a negative outlook. Ongoing political divisions that stall fiscal consolidation make this review especially closely watched.

Credit pressure is not limited to AI; high‑yield bond risk premiums are rising in tandem. The market also worries that the AI‑related debt burden of tech giants may be larger than publicly known. S&P Global warned on October 19 that the actual AI‑related debt risk borne by large cloud providers could exceed current market perception.

Broader credit indicators are shifting as well. LSEG data show that the CDX high‑yield index, which tracks North American speculative‑grade corporate credit risk, had a five‑year mid‑quote spread of 355.35 basis points on October 20, about 39 basis points wider than at the end of 2025.

This demonstrates a trend of investors demanding higher risk premiums that is not confined to AI‑related borrowers. Whether corporate expansions can generate sufficient cash flow and whether governments can rein in deficits are now being tested more rigorously by the credit market.

items.title: 馬斯克砸10億美元進軍好萊塢？傳入股Skydance
items.title_en: Elon Musk Pours $1 Billion into Hollywood? Stake in Skydance
paras: 據《Semafor》周四(22日)報導，馬斯克已向Skydance(SKYD-US)投資約10億美元，這筆注資是該公司擴大股權募資計畫的一部分。Skydance剛完成大型媒體併購，正推動業務整合與成本削減，同時面臨近800億美元的債務負擔。消息傳出後，股價下跌約1%。
派拉蒙已於10月6日完成收購華納兄弟探索，合併後公司更名為Skydance，股票代號也改為SKYD。sec.gov共同執行長David Ellison與Ynon Kreiz目前肩負整合任務，涵蓋派拉蒙與華納兄弟兩大電影製片廠、Paramount+與HBO Max兩個串流平台，以及支援旗下電視頻道與兩個新聞部門的企業職能。
Skydance先前表示，預計在三年內實現60億美元的成本節省。不過，合併後近800億美元的債務，也使公司在整合業務之際，面臨沉重財務負擔。
《Semafor》指出，馬斯克的投資承諾屬於Skydance尋求股權資金的更廣泛行動。截至報導發布，馬斯克與Skydance代表均未立即回應《CNBC》的置評請求。
馬斯克與Ellison家族過去已有多次投資往來。David Ellison的父親、甲骨文(ORCL-US)共同創辦人Larry Ellison，曾在馬斯克2022年收購Twitter、也就是如今的X時，投入10億美元。
Larry Ellison也曾於2018年投資特斯拉(TSLA-US)，並擔任該公司董事。在派拉蒙收購華納兄弟探索的交易中，他更親自為逾400億美元的股權融資提供擔保。
paras_en: According to Semafor on Thursday (the 22nd), Elon Musk has invested roughly $1 billion in Skydance (SKYD‑US). The capital injection is part of the company’s expanded equity‑raising plan. Skydance has just completed a large media merger and is pushing business integration and cost cuts while carrying about $80 billion of debt. The news sent the stock down about 1 %.

Paramount completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on Oct. 6, and the combined company was renamed Skydance, with the ticker changing to SKYD. Co‑CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz are now tasked with integrating the two major film studios—Paramount and Warner Bros.—as well as the Paramount+ and HBO Max streaming platforms, plus the corporate functions that support the TV channels and two news divisions.

Skydance previously said it expects to achieve $6 billion in cost savings over three years. However, the post‑merger debt load of nearly $80 billion also leaves the company with a heavy financial burden as it works to integrate the businesses.

Semafor noted that Musk’s investment pledge is part of a broader effort by Skydance to raise equity capital. As of the time of the report, neither Musk nor Skydance representatives had responded to CNBC’s request for comment.

Musk and the Ellison family have a history of multiple investments together. David Ellison’s father, Oracle co‑founder Larry Ellison, put $1 billion into Musk’s 2022 acquisition of Twitter, now rebranded as X.
Larry Ellison also invested in Tesla (TSLA‑US) in 2018 and served on its board. In the Paramount‑Warner Bros. Discovery deal, he personally guaranteed more than $40 billion of equity financing.

items.title: 買公債就有高收益！投資人還願意押注生技股嗎？
items.title_en: High Yields from Government Bonds! Are Investors Still Willing to Bet on Biotech Stocks?
paras: 美國公債殖利率快速攀升，正削弱高風險生技股的吸引力。對許多尚未獲利、押注突破性療法的業者而言，投資結果可能是巨額回報，也可能近乎歸零。當相對安全的公債提供更高收益，投資人開始重新衡量承擔新藥研發風險是否值得。
據《彭博》報導，那斯達克生技指數自8月19日高點回落3.8%，同期美國10年期公債殖利率攀升近0.5個百分點，一度觸及5.34%，創2002年以來最高。該指數涵蓋近250家生技公司，今年仍上漲約25%，但近期回檔已反映利率壓力。

公債收益提高 生技業融資與現金壓力加劇

White Manna Capital創辦人暨投資長William Soliman指出，投資人如今有收益更高的無風險替代選項，使早期生技公司的投資吸引力面臨挑戰。對距離創造營收可能還有數年的企業，投資人將要求更高的風險溢價，才願意承擔臨床、監管與融資風險。
能源價格飆升與企業大舉借款投入AI，推動美債殖利率走高，也凸顯市場擔心通膨持續，讓原本資金吃緊的生技業處境更艱難。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，那斯達克生技指數成分股中，過去一年獲利者不到四分之一，約半數公司的現金不足以支應六個月日常開銷。高利率進一步提高資金成本與再融資風險。

新藥成果仍有吸引力 資金回流卻添阻力

儘管如此，Gabelli基金經理人Elena Meng仍看好生技業長期前景，表示投資流程原本就會評估估值、資金成本與現金能支撐多久，利率變動不會根本改變其策略。
今年部分業者也交出亮眼成果。Moderna(MRNA-US)與默沙東(MRK-US)治療黑色素瘤的正面試驗數據，帶動Moderna股價在連跌四年後，今年大漲逾700%。Revolution Medicines(RVMD-US)延長晚期胰臟癌患者壽命的口服藥獲美國核准，股價今年上漲逾140%。
RBC Capital Markets分析師則認為，若AI行情退燒，生技股可望受惠於資金從科技股轉出。不過，Baird醫療產業專家Mike Perrone提醒，臨床試驗結果仍左右股價，幾家大型業者若傳出壞消息，就可能打擊市場熱情。
基因編輯業者Caribou Biosciences(CRBU-US)本月宣布終止兩項療法計畫，評估合併或被收購等選項，並規劃裁員與削減成本，今年股價已跌逾60%。Perrone指出，高利率這項明確逆風，將讓重視總體環境的跨產業投資人，對重返生技股更加猶豫。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields are climbing rapidly, eroding the appeal of high‑risk biotech stocks. For many unprofitable firms betting on breakthrough therapies, the payoff could be massive or near zero. When relatively safe Treasuries offer higher returns, investors begin to reassess whether the risk of new‑drug development is worth it.

According to Bloomberg, the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index fell 3.8% from its August 19 peak as the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose nearly 0.5 percentage points, briefly hitting 5.34% – the highest level since 2002. The index, which covers about 250 biotech companies, is up roughly 25% year‑to‑date, but the recent pullback reflects pressure from rising rates.

Higher bond yields tighten financing and cash conditions for biotech. William Soliman, founder and CIO of White Manna Capital, said investors now have a higher‑yielding, risk‑free alternative, challenging the attractiveness of early‑stage biotech investments. For companies that may not generate revenue for years, investors will demand a larger risk premium to take on clinical, regulatory and financing risk.

Surging energy prices and massive corporate borrowing to fund AI have pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, underscoring market worries about persistent inflation and making an already cash‑constrained biotech sector even tougher.

Bloomberg’s data show that less than a quarter of Nasdaq Biotechnology Index constituents were profitable over the past year, and about half lack enough cash to cover six months of operating expenses. High rates further raise capital costs and refinancing risk.

Despite this, Gabelli fund manager Elena Meng remains bullish on the long‑term outlook for biotech, noting that investment decisions already factor valuation, cost of capital and cash runway, and that interest‑rate moves do not fundamentally alter the strategy.

Some companies have delivered standout results this year. Moderna (MRNA‑US) and Merck (MRK‑US) posted positive trial data for melanoma treatments, sending Moderna’s stock soaring more than 700% after four years of decline. Revolution Medicines (RVMD‑US) received U.S. approval for an oral drug that extends survival in late‑stage pancreatic cancer, lifting its share price over 140% this year.

RBC Capital Markets analysts argue that if the AI rally cools, biotech could benefit from capital rotating out of tech stocks. However, Baird healthcare expert Mike Perrone cautions that clinical trial outcomes still drive stock prices, and negative news from a few large players could dampen market enthusiasm.

Gene‑editing firm Caribou Biosciences (CRBU‑US) announced this month that it is terminating two therapy programs, evaluating merger or acquisition options, and planning layoffs and cost cuts; its stock has already fallen more than 60% this year. Perrone notes that high rates are a clear headwind, making cross‑industry investors who consider the broader environment more hesitant to return to biotech stocks.

items.title: 美光投資思維該轉變了？分析師：AI記憶體需求是場馬拉松
items.title_en: Is Micron's Investment Thinking Due for a Shift? Analyst Says AI Memory Demand Is a Marathon
paras: 美光(MU-US)近期股價疲弱，反映投資人再度質疑人工智慧(AI)支出的持久性。根據《MarketWatch》訪調的多名分析師，市場對美光的期待可能需要調整：記憶體市場的成長未必很快觸頂，投資人應把眼光放得更長遠，將AI需求視為一場馬拉松，而非短跑。
Stifel分析師Brian Chin表示，雖然近期引發跌勢的疑慮並非美光獨有，但仍讓投資人思考，究竟什麼因素才能重新帶動這檔指標性AI概念股上漲。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson則說，若需求放緩，記憶體受到的衝擊可能比其他零組件更大，因為「問題不只是銷量或出貨量，最終還會演變成價格問題」。換言之，美光及其他記憶體供應商目前能夠收取高價，是因為需求強勁，一旦市場環境轉弱，客戶就不願再支付如此高的價格。
考量到AI泡沫不太可能立即破裂，在市場焦慮升高、基本面卻尚未出現太大變化之際，分析師會如何建議客戶應對？

記憶體市場成長還能持續多久？低本益比提供一定支撐

《MarketWatch》指出，首先值得思考的是，記憶體市場的高速成長還能持續多久。部分投資人擔心，需求可能在兩季後出現負面轉折，但Chin表示，實際情況可能是兩到三年後才發生。
他補充，只要強勁的市場環境能夠維持這麼久，美光EPS就可能遠高於目前水準。不過，Chin不認為美光的本益比會大幅攀升，目前股價約為他預估未來EPS的五倍。
從正面來看，美光目前的本益比相當低，進一步壓縮的空間有限。Chin表示，只要獲利至少能緩步成長，這項特性就能讓美光股價「具有一定的防禦性」。
Gabelli Funds分析師Ryuta Makino表示，從相對估值來看，美光具備吸引力，尤其與儲存類股相比，美光股價的估值倍數較低。

供給擴張受限 供應鏈瓶頸恐減緩產能成長

除了需求放緩，投資人還必須留意市場供給。如果美光或競爭對手增加的供給過多，可能削弱整個產業維持記憶體高價的能力，而目前各家業者都已有擴充產能的計畫。
不過，Chin指出，半導體設備製造商目前難以迅速提高晶片製造設備的供應，因此「供應鏈的摩擦將限制供給成長速度」。
他認為，記憶體市場的投資邏輯正從短跑轉向長距離馬拉松，「現階段投資美光，需要的就是這種心態。」

AI融資風險成壓力 但記憶體供需仍趨緊

接下來是融資問題。美光的現金部位持續增加，但部分AI晶片買家愈來愈依賴借貸資金，支撐整個AI生態系的運作。Makino表示，市場對AI相關投資債務不斷攀升的疑慮，正在拖累美光股價。
他指出，前沿AI研究機構與新一代雲端服務供應商的自由現金流均為負值，在此同時，記憶體價格上漲正在推升資料中心伺服器價格，「進一步加劇融資風險」。
儘管如此，Makino表示，目前供需狀況依然吃緊，他預期明年到2028年，供需還會進一步收緊。
整體而言，Bryson並未看到需求放緩的跡象，但預期記憶體相關交易仍將持續波動。
美光股價周三早盤走勢震盪，一度上漲3.6%，隨後短暫轉跌，終場上漲約2%至每股913.67美元。美光目前股價以從6月高點下跌26%，但今年來仍上漲逾三倍。
Bryson說：「運算產業的歷史告訴我們，支援各種應用需要更多記憶體。如果你相信未來會有更多AI應用，就代表需要更多記憶體來支援這些應用。」
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) has seen weak recent stock performance, reflecting renewed investor doubts about the durability of AI spending. According to multiple analysts surveyed by MarketWatch, expectations for Micron may need to be adjusted: memory market growth may not peak quickly, and investors should take a longer view, treating AI demand as a marathon rather than a sprint.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin noted that while the recent concerns driving the decline are not unique to Micron, they still prompt investors to consider what factors could reignite this flagship AI‑themed stock.

Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson added that if demand eases, memory could feel the impact more than other components because “the issue isn’t just volume or shipments; it ultimately becomes a pricing problem.” In other words, Micron and other memory suppliers can command high prices now because demand is strong, but customers will balk at paying those premiums if the market softens.
Given that an AI bubble is unlikely to burst immediately, how will analysts advise clients to respond amid rising market anxiety but still‑stable fundamentals?

How long can memory market growth continue? Low P/E provides some support. MarketWatch points out that the first question is how long the rapid growth in memory can be sustained. Some investors fear a negative turn in demand two quarters out, but Chin says the reality may not materialize until two to three years later.

He added that if a strong market environment can be maintained that long, Micron’s EPS could be far above current levels. However, Chin does not expect Micron’s price‑to‑earnings ratio to climb dramatically; the current share price is about five times his projected future EPS.

On the positive side, Micron’s P/E is currently quite low, leaving limited room for further compression. Chin says that as long as earnings can at least grow modestly, this characteristic gives Micron’s stock “a certain defensive quality.”
Gabelli Funds analyst Ryuta Makino said that on a relative‑valuation basis, Micron is attractive, especially compared with storage‑focused stocks, where Micron’s valuation multiple is lower.

Supply expansion is constrained; supply‑chain bottlenecks may slow capacity growth. In addition to demand slowdown, investors must watch market supply. If Micron or rivals add too much capacity, it could weaken the industry’s ability to sustain high memory prices, and all players already have expansion plans underway.
However, Chin points out that semiconductor equipment makers cannot quickly ramp up chip‑making equipment supply, so “supply‑chain friction will limit the speed of supply growth.”
He believes the investment logic for memory is shifting from a sprint to a long‑distance marathon, and “investing in Micron at this stage requires that mindset.”

AI financing risk is a pressure point, but memory supply‑and‑demand remains tight. Micron’s cash balance continues to grow, yet some AI chip buyers are increasingly reliant on borrowed funds to sustain the AI ecosystem. Makino says market worries about rising AI‑related investment debt are weighing on Micron’s share price.

He noted that leading AI research institutions and next‑generation cloud service providers are posting negative free cash flow, while rising memory prices are pushing up data‑center server prices, “further aggravating financing risk.”
Nevertheless, Makino says the current supply‑demand balance is still tight, and he expects it to tighten further from next year through 2028.
Overall, Bryson does not see signs of demand slowing, but expects memory‑related transactions to remain volatile.

Micron’s stock was volatile in early Wednesday trade, briefly rising 3.6% before a short dip, and closed up about 2% at $913.67 per share. The stock is down 26% from its June peak but has more than tripled year‑to‑date.

Bryson said: “History of the computing industry tells us that supporting a variety of applications requires more memory. If you believe there will be more AI applications in the future, that means more memory will be needed to support those applications.”

items.title: 金管會准了！永豐金證券併京城證 11/23合併基準日
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Approves! SinoPac Securities to Merge with Jingcheng Securities, Merger Effective Date Set for November 23, 2026
paras: 金管會今(22)日宣布通過永豐金證券合併京城證券，合併基準日預定為今 (2026) 年 11 月 23 日。未來經紀業務市占率將增加至5.113%，市占率排名維持第 4。
永豐金證券為擴大經紀業務規模及提升營運效率及綜效，經雙方依公司法第128條之1規定召開代行股東會職權之董事會決議通過合併案，由永豐金證券吸收合併京城證券，京城證券原有之2個據點將併入永豐金證券之另外2個鄰近分支機構，不另設分公司，合併後業務據點維持46處。
依公司申請書件說明，合併後預期經紀業務市占率增加至5.113%，市占率排名維持第4名，合併有助於擴大經濟規模，提升整體營運績效，並提供更多元化之金融商品服務。
證期局指出，永豐金證券資本額為新台幣172.3億元、京城證券資本額為2.3億元。其中，永豐金證券員工數為2668人，京城證券則為43人，員工將全數留用。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (22) that it has approved the merger of SinoPac Securities with Jingcheng Securities, with the merger effective date scheduled for November 23, 2026. After the merger, the brokerage market share is expected to rise to 5.113%, maintaining its rank at fourth place.

SinoPac Securities, aiming to expand its brokerage scale and improve operational efficiency and synergies, held a board meeting in accordance with Article 128‑1 of the Company Act to approve the merger. SinoPac will absorb Jingcheng Securities; Jingcheng’s two existing locations will be integrated into two nearby SinoPac branches, with no new subsidiaries created, and the total number of business locations will remain at 46.

According to the companies’ application documents, the post‑merger brokerage market share is projected to increase to 5.113%, keeping the fourth‑place ranking. The merger is expected to broaden economies of scale, boost overall operational performance, and provide a more diversified range of financial product services.

The Securities and Futures Bureau noted that SinoPac Securities has a capital of NT$17.23 billion, while Jingcheng Securities has a capital of NT$0.23 billion. SinoPac employs 2,668 staff members and Jingcheng 43 staff members, all of whom will be retained.

items.title: 台積電評估赴美德州擴產 同步尋求無稀土馬達降低中國供應風險
items.title_en: TSMC Evaluates Expanding Production in Texas While Seeking Rare‑Earth‑Free Motors to Reduce China Supply Risk
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI晶片需求持續超過供給，台積電(2330-TW)正評估進一步擴大美國製造布局，除了既有的亞利桑那州投資計畫，也已派遣團隊前往德州尋找設廠機會。另一方面，面對中國加強稀土出口管制，台積電也開始尋求不使用稀土材料的設備零組件，希望降低晶圓廠自動化設備對中國供應鏈的依賴。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家證實，公司正與馬斯克提出的Terafab晶片製造計畫進行討論，對參與合作或持有相關製造設施保持開放態度。同時，今日也傳出，台積電已向設備供應商了解採用無稀土馬達的可行性，相關評估仍處於初期階段，尚未大規模導入。
稀土磁鐵廣泛使用於工業馬達，包括晶圓廠自動化設備的傳動系統。中國自2025年起對部分稀土材料、磁鐵及加工技術實施出口管制，使半導體設備供應鏈面臨潛在斷料風險。對高度自動化的先進晶圓廠而言，一旦關鍵馬達零組件無法正常取得，可能影響設備維修及產線運作。
事實上，無稀土馬達技術已逐步商業化。ABB、西門子Siemens、WEG及日本電產Nidec等國際大廠，均持續擴大同步磁阻馬達產品布局，相關產品已可達到IE5超高效率等級，主要應用於工業泵浦、風扇及空壓機等設備。台灣東元(1504-TW)也已量產不使用稀土磁鐵的高效率同步磁阻馬達，並實際應用於電子廠廠務水泵，產品已銷往歐美市場。
從市場規模來看，研究機構Mordor Intelligence預估，全球同步磁阻馬達市場將由2024年的1.95億美元，增加至2030年的2.40億美元，年複合成長率約3.63%。過去企業採用這類馬達主要著眼於節能效率，如今隨著中國稀土出口限制增加供應不確定性，降低對稀土磁鐵的依賴也逐漸成為設備採購考量。
不過，現有無稀土馬達主要用於工業及廠務設備，若要進一步導入半導體精密製程設備，仍須符合設備原廠對控制精度、運轉穩定性及可靠度的要求。台積電目前僅處於供應商評估階段，尚未確認採用產品或合作廠商，後續替代設計及設備驗證進度仍有待觀察。

paras_en: October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – As demand for AI chips continues to outstrip supply, TSMC (2330‑TW) is assessing further expansion of its U.S. manufacturing footprint. In addition to its existing Arizona investment plan, the company has dispatched a team to Texas to explore plant opportunities. Meanwhile, facing tighter Chinese rare‑earth export controls, TSMC is also looking into equipment components that do not use rare‑earth materials, aiming to lower its fab automation reliance on Chinese supply chains.

TSMC Chairman and President Wei Che‑chia confirmed that the company is discussing participation in Elon Musk’s Terafab chip‑manufacturing project and remains open to cooperating on or holding related manufacturing facilities. At the same time, reports say TSMC has queried equipment suppliers about the feasibility of using rare‑earth‑free motors; the assessment is still in its early stages and has not yet been rolled out on a large scale.

Rare‑earth magnets are widely used in industrial motors, including the drive systems of semiconductor fab automation equipment. Starting in 2025, China will impose export controls on certain rare‑earth materials, magnets and processing technologies, creating a potential material‑supply risk for the semiconductor equipment supply chain. For highly automated advanced fabs, an inability to obtain critical motor components could disrupt equipment maintenance and production line operation.

In fact, rare‑earth‑free motor technology is gradually becoming commercialized. International giants such as ABB, Siemens, WEG and Japan’s Nidec are expanding their synchronous reluctance motor product lines, with offerings that achieve IE5 ultra‑high efficiency ratings and are used in industrial pumps, fans and compressors. Taiwan’s TECO (1504‑TW) has also mass‑produced high‑efficiency synchronous reluctance motors that do not use rare‑earth magnets, deploying them in water‑pump systems for electronics factories and exporting the products to Europe and the United States.

In terms of market size, research firm Mordor Intelligence estimates the global synchronous reluctance motor market will grow from $195 million in 2024 to $240 million by 2030, a compound annual growth rate of about 3.63%. Historically, companies adopted these motors mainly for energy‑saving efficiency; now, with China’s rare‑earth export restrictions adding supply uncertainty, reducing reliance on rare‑earth magnets is becoming an increasingly important procurement consideration.

However, existing rare‑earth‑free motors are primarily used in industrial and plant‑facility equipment. To be introduced into semiconductor precision‑process equipment, they must meet original‑equipment‑manufacturer requirements for control accuracy, operational stability and reliability. TSMC is currently only at the supplier‑evaluation stage, has not confirmed any product adoption or partner, and further design substitution and equipment validation progress remains to be seen.

items.title: 〈房產〉9月五大銀行新承做房貸增逾百億元 央行這樣解讀
items.title_en: Real Estate: September sees the five major banks' new mortgage issuance rise by over NT$10 billion; the central bank’s interpretation
paras: 中央銀行今 (22) 日公布9 月五大銀行 (台銀、合庫銀、土銀、華銀和一銀) 新承做放款統計，新承做房貸較上月增加126.18億元至697.83億元，不過，房貸利率2.315%較上月略下滑0.006個百分點。
央行說明，五大銀行新承做房貸較上月增加，主要是因民俗月結束，加上部分新建案交屋，因此，不能說是房市轉熱，至於9月理監事會議鬆綁房市，政策效果還有待觀察。
央行也統計，9月五大銀行新青安貸款占整體新承做購屋貸款比重較上月增加1.22個百分點至43.1%。
另外，央行指出，AI供應鏈相關企業備料、搶料等，帶動週轉金需求增加，9月貸款金額達1兆1562億元，創2023年4月以來新高。
由於市場整體資金需求偏高，包括資本支出貸款、週轉金貸款、消費性貸款等利率均較上月上揚。
paras_en: The central bank today (22nd) released September statistics for the five major banks (Taiwan Bank, Cooperative Bank, Land Bank, Hua Nan Bank and First Bank) on new loan disbursements. New mortgage loans rose by NT$12.618 billion from the previous month to NT$69.783 billion, while the mortgage rate slipped slightly to 2.315%, down 0.006 percentage points from the prior month.

The central bank explained that the increase in new mortgages is mainly due to the end of the lunar New Year holiday and the handover of some newly built projects, so it cannot be taken as a sign that the housing market is heating up. As for the September board meeting that loosened housing‑market restrictions, the policy effect remains to be seen.
The central bank also reported that the share of new green loans among total new home‑purchase loans rose by 1.22 percentage points month‑over‑month to 43.1%.

Additionally, the central bank noted that AI‑related supply‑chain companies' material procurement and rush orders have boosted demand for working capital, pushing September loan volume to NT$1.01562 trillion, a new high since April 2023.
Because overall market demand for funds remains high, interest rates on capital‑expenditure loans, working‑capital loans and consumer loans all rose compared with the previous month.

items.title: 4檔處置股因颱風順延10/27抓去關 PCB飆股金居處置到11/2止
items.title_en: Four Disposition Stocks Delayed to Oct. 27 Due to Typhoon; PCB‑Surge Stock Jinju to Remain Under Disposition Until Nov. 2
paras: 櫃買中心今(22)日公告新增4檔處置股，因明(23)日剛好遇到颱風休市一日，加上下周一(26日)為台灣光復節補假一日，上市、上櫃市場預計於下周二(10月27日)恢復正常開盤交易，處置日也順延至10月27日，除了科嶠(4542-TW)自10月27日處置到11月4日止，共7日，其餘包括金居(8358-TW)、中茂(5205-TW)、大地-KY(8437-TW)等3檔，皆自周二起處置到11月2日、共5日，4檔處置股交易時間皆為每 2分鐘撮合一次，主管機關呼籲投資人能留意。
金居處置原因為當日本益比為65.35、股價淨值比為11.9且為其所屬產業類別股價淨值比之3.09倍、當日周轉率達6.95%。
科嶠處置原因為當日本益比為158.26、股價淨值比為12.66且為其所屬產業類別股價淨值比之3.28倍、當日周轉率達6.66%。
另因科嶠因本益比異常，且周轉率過大，受處置時間長達7個交易日。
中茂處置原因最近6個營業日(含今日)累積之最後成交價跌幅達31.9%。
大地-KY處置原因最近6個營業日(含今日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達28.64%，當日之成交量較最近60個營業日日平均成交量放大14.01倍；元大證券公司當日受託買進該有價證券之成交量占當日該有價證券總成交量之比率為39.01%。
paras_en: The OTC market announced today (Oct 22) that four stocks will be placed under disposition. Because the market will be closed on Oct 23 due to a typhoon and next Monday (Oct 26) is a make‑up holiday for Taiwan’s Restoration Day, the listed and OTC markets are expected to resume normal trading on Tuesday, Oct 27. Consequently, the disposition dates are pushed to Oct 27. Apart from KEO (4542‑TW), which will be disposed from Oct 27 through Nov 4 (seven days), the other three stocks – Jinju (8358‑TW), Zhongmao (5205‑TW) and Dadi‑KY (8437‑TW) – will be disposed from Tuesday through Nov 2 (five days). All four stocks will be matched every two minutes, and regulators urge investors to stay alert.
Jinju’s disposition is triggered by a Japanese P/E ratio of 65.35, a price‑to‑book ratio of 11.9, which is 3.09 times the industry‑average P/B, and a turnover rate of 6.95% on the day.
KEO’s disposition is triggered by a Japanese P/E ratio of 158.26, a price‑to‑book ratio of 12.66, which is 3.28 times the industry‑average P/B, and a turnover rate of 6.66% on the day.
KEO is also subject to a longer disposition period of seven trading days because its P/E ratio is abnormal and its turnover rate is excessively high.
Zhongmao’s disposition reason is that the cumulative decline in its last‑trade price over the most recent six trading days (including today) reached 31.9%.

Dadi‑KY’s disposition reason is that the cumulative increase in its last‑trade price over the most recent six trading days (including today) reached 28.64%, and its trading volume on the day was 14.01 times the average volume of the past 60 trading days; Yuan‑Da Securities’ purchases accounted for 39.01% of the total volume of the security that day.

items.title: 台股10/23因颱風休市！程曦、藍新掛牌順延 興櫃3新兵延至下周登場
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Closed on Oct 23 Due to Typhoon! Chengxi and Lanxin Listings Delayed, OTC New Listings Postponed to Next Week
paras: 受薔琵颱風影響，台北市政府宣布明(23)日停止上班上課，金融市場也全部休市，明天共有 2 家上櫃、3 家興櫃公司的掛牌順延辦理。
櫃買中心原定於 10/23 舉辦的程曦資訊(6898-TW) 與藍新資訊(6938-TW)上櫃掛牌典禮，將順延辦理。
原訂 23 日登錄興櫃的翰可能源(7859-TW)、亞昕科技(7960-TW)及宇田控制(7962-TW)，因明日休市及 10/26 下周一為台灣光復節補假日，掛牌日期預計順延至 10/27 下周二。
明日預定進行除權息與現金增資相關作業之公司，日程順延一天辦理，包括威致(2028-TW)原定 10/23 發放現金股利 0.2 元；青松健康(6931-TW)原定 10/23 發放現金股利 0.12 元；鼎晉生技(7876-TW)原定 10/23 辦理現金增資 1.5 億元(認購率 11.8057%，認購價 40 元)。
部分預定於明日發放現金股利的上市櫃公司，若投資人選擇以「匯款轉帳」方式領取，因停班地區金融機構的匯款轉帳作業日程需順延至下一營業日，因此受停班影響縣市的投資人，現金股利入帳日將順延 1 天；至於未受颱風停班影響縣市之投資人，則仍會依原訂日期收到現金股利。
paras_en: Due to Typhoon Saola, the Taipei City Government announced that tomorrow (the 23rd) will be a holiday for work and school, and the entire financial market will be closed. As a result, the listing ceremonies for two OTC‑listed companies and three Emerging Stock Board companies will be postponed.
The OTC market’s planned listing ceremonies for Chengxi Information (6898‑TW) and Lanxin Information (6938‑TW) that were scheduled for Oct. 23 will be delayed.

The three companies that were slated to be listed on the Emerging Stock Board on the 23rd—Han Ke Neng Yuan (7859‑TW), Yaxin Technology (7960‑TW) and Yutian Control (7962‑TW)—will have their listing dates pushed back to Oct. 27 (next Tuesday) because of tomorrow’s market closure and the upcoming holiday on Oct. 26 for Taiwan’s Restoration Day.

Companies that were scheduled to carry out ex‑dividend and cash‑increase operations tomorrow will have their timelines shifted by one day, including Wei Zhi (2028‑TW) which was to pay a cash dividend of NT$0.20 per share on Oct. 23; Qingsong Health (6931‑TW) which was to pay a cash dividend of NT$0.12 per share on Oct. 23; and Dingjin Biotech (7876‑TW) which was to conduct a cash capital increase of NT$150 million on Oct. 23 (subscription rate 11.8057%, subscription price NT$40).

For listed companies that were to distribute cash dividends tomorrow, investors who choose to receive the dividend via bank transfer will experience a one‑day delay in the credit date if their local banks are closed due to the typhoon. Investors in regions unaffected by the holiday will still receive the dividend on the originally scheduled date.

items.title: 高雄食品展集結300家國內外企業 助本土業者拓展出口商機
items.title_en: Kaohsiung Food Expo Brings Together 300 Domestic and International Companies to Help Local Businesses Expand Export Opportunities
paras: 由經濟部國貿署主辦的「2026高雄國際食品展」由貿協攜手主辦的「高雄國際飯店、餐飲暨烘焙設備用品展」，今(22)日在高雄展覽館聯合開幕。本屆以「港都鮮味，國際食代」為主軸，集結13國、300家國內外企業，使用逾520個攤位，展現台灣食品、水產及餐飲設備產業的多元實力與國際競爭力。
為協助業者拓展海外市場，展覽期間舉辦「高雄食品國際通路商採購大會」，邀集15國、逾40名國際買主來臺，預計進行超過400 場一對一採購洽談，協助臺灣食品與設備業者對接國際通路、掌握市場需求，拓展出口商機。
經濟部國貿署署長劉威亷表示，高雄國際食品展是南台灣重要的食品產業交流平台，展現臺灣農漁業、食品加工及餐飲產業的多元實力，也為國內外業者創造交流合作與拓展市場的機會，本屆展覽呼應全球淨零碳排與產業轉型趨勢，首度設立「遠洋漁業區」及「綠色永續館」。
其中「遠洋漁業區」呈現臺灣從遠洋捕撈、加工製造到餐桌應用的完整產業鏈，展出多項優質水產加工品；「綠色永續館」則聚焦有機耕作、減塑包裝及循環配送等創新方案，展現臺灣食品產業推動環境永續的成果，展覽結合公益團體設攤，展現企業社會責任，鼓勵民眾以消費支持多元就業。
本屆展覽吸引多國駐台使節與重要外賓參與，深化國際經貿交流。馬紹爾群島天然資源暨商務部長Anthony Muller 親自出席國家館開幕，並率領7家業者展出太平洋特色產品，促進台馬經貿合作。
另由馬紹爾群島、拉丁美洲及史瓦帝尼共同展成的「友邦食光」專區，以及日本貿易振興機構帶來的靜岡茶、廣島牡蠣、秋田牛等地方特色食材，均為展場亮點。國內業者也展出獲獎茶品、蜂蜜等優質農特產品；餐飲設備區則展出智慧化、節能及高效能設備，呼應產業數位轉型與節能減碳趨勢。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ International Trade Administration hosts the "2026 Kaohsiung International Food Expo," co‑organized with the Trade Promotion Council’s "Kaohsiung International Hotel, Restaurant and Bakery Equipment Expo," which opened today (22) at the Kaohsiung Exhibition Center. The theme this year is "Port City Fresh Flavors, International Food Era," gathering 300 companies from 13 countries across more than 520 booths to showcase Taiwan’s diverse food, seafood and catering equipment industries and their global competitiveness.

To help companies break into overseas markets, the expo will hold a "Kaohsiung Food International Channel Buyers Procurement Conference" during the exhibition, inviting over 40 international buyers from 15 countries. More than 400 one‑on‑one procurement meetings are planned to connect Taiwanese food and equipment firms with global distribution channels, gauge market demand and expand export opportunities.

Liu Wei‑lian, Director of the International Trade Administration, said the Kaohsiung International Food Expo is a key platform for the food industry in southern Taiwan, displaying the island’s agricultural, fisheries, food‑processing and catering strengths while creating networking and market‑expansion chances for domestic and foreign participants. This year’s show aligns with global net‑zero and industry‑transformation trends, debuting a "Deep‑Sea Fisheries Zone" and a "Green Sustainability Pavilion."

The "Deep‑Sea Fisheries Zone" presents Taiwan’s full value chain—from offshore catch and processing to table‑side applications—featuring a range of premium seafood products. The "Green Sustainability Pavilion" focuses on organic farming, reduced‑plastic packaging and circular logistics solutions, highlighting Taiwan’s progress toward environmental sustainability in the food sector. The exhibition also partners with NGOs for booths that demonstrate corporate social responsibility and encourage consumers to support diverse employment through their purchases.

The event attracted numerous diplomatic representatives and distinguished guests, deepening international trade dialogue. Anthony Muller, Minister of Natural Resources and Commerce of the Marshall Islands, attended the opening of the national pavilion and led seven local firms showcasing Pacific‑region specialty products, bolstering Taiwan‑Marshall Islands trade ties.

A special "Friend Nations Food Zone" co‑organized by the Marshall Islands, Latin America and Eswatini, along with Japan’s JETRO showcasing Shizuoka tea, Hiroshima oysters and Akita beef, were exhibition highlights. Domestic exhibitors also displayed award‑winning teas, honey and other premium agricultural products, while the catering equipment area featured smart, energy‑saving and high‑efficiency machinery, reflecting the industry’s digital transformation and carbon‑reduction drive.

items.title: 因應全球氣候變遷 賴清德祭兩大戰略因應 年底提「國家都市林推動計畫」
items.title_en: In Response to Global Climate Change, Lai Ching‑de Announces Two Major Strategies and a National Urban Forest Initiative by Year‑end
paras: 總統賴清德今(22)日主持「國家氣候變遷對策委員會第9次委員會議」時表示，面對氣候變遷衝擊，國家必須提升因應能力與韌性，提出「兼顧即時應變與長期調適，守護國人健康安全」及「強化運輸系統韌性，加速綠色交通轉型」兩大關鍵戰略。
另繼上(9)月完成以極端高溫為情境的實兵演練後，賴清德也透露，政府將完善高溫防護與應變機制，今(2026)年底將提出「國家都市林推動計畫」及都市林專法，讓台灣都市林走向全國性的行動。
賴清德表示，包括世界氣象組織(WMO)今年9月再次發出警訊，聖嬰現象預計在未來幾個月進一步增強，並在年底達到高峰，很有可能創下歷史新高，形成「超級聖嬰」，對氣候的影響將持續到明(2027)年，隨著海面溫度與氣溫持續上升，全球都面臨著極端天氣的挑戰，聯合國也多次呼籲，極端高溫是全社會的威脅，需要政府各部門共同因應，特別要照顧脆弱族群、確保工作環境安全，及早做好高溫防護的準備。
面對氣候變遷對生活與經濟帶來的衝擊，賴清德表示，國家必須提升因應能力與韌性，提出兩大關鍵戰略。
第一，兼顧即時應變與長期調適，守護國人健康安全。高溫直接關係到人民的生命與健康，像是戶外工作者、獨居長者、孩童以及慢性病患者，面對極端高溫常態化，必須強化政府與民間、跨部會與跨區域合作，建立主動預防、共同應變的高溫防護機制。
賴清德強調，目前政府已經串聯全國超過1萬處的「涼適點」，提供民眾就近避暑的場所。有些參與的企業和店家，甚至貼心地在門口貼公告表達，只要覺得太熱不舒服，可以入內吹冷氣休息，不消費也沒關係。
此外，上個月環境部結合中央、地方及醫療體系共50個單位，完成台灣首次以40度極端高溫為情境的實兵演練，來檢驗熱傷害救護、弱勢關懷及重要設施的應變能力。
第二，強化運輸系統韌性，加速綠色交通轉型。台灣是人口與產業高度集中的海島型國家，陸海空運輸，不僅是經濟發展的命脈，更是維持社會運作與防災應變的基石。
賴清德指出，在交通防災韌性上，過去東部鐵公路因天災中斷時，交通部立即啟動海運備援，維持必要的疏運，這項經驗讓我們看到，整合不同運輸系統、建立備援機制的重要性。
賴清德表示，政府將根據演練成果，進一步完善高溫防護與應變機制，並納入「第四期國家氣候變遷調適行動計畫」，全面強化高溫預警、勞工防護、社區關懷與跨部會應變，政府也會延續今年4月第7次會議提出的，「國土綠蔭調適戰略」，優先改善高溫、遮蔭不足的地區，讓自然綠蔭成為天然防護傘，打造更宜居、安全的生活環境。
paras_en: President Lai Ching‑de chaired the 9th meeting of the National Climate Change Commission today, saying that in the face of climate impacts the country must boost its capacity and resilience, and put forward two key strategies: “balancing immediate response with long‑term adaptation to protect the health and safety of the people” and “strengthening transport system resilience and accelerating the green mobility transition.”

After completing a live‑fire drill in September that used extreme heat as a scenario, Lai also revealed that the government will refine heat‑protection and response mechanisms and will present a “National Urban Forest Promotion Plan” and a dedicated urban‑forest law by the end of 2026, turning Taiwan’s urban forests into a nationwide effort.

Lai noted that the World Meteorological Organization issued another warning in September, forecasting that the El Niño will intensify over the coming months, peak by year‑end and possibly reach a historic “super‑El Niño” level, with climate effects lasting into 2027. As sea‑surface and air temperatures keep rising, the world faces extreme weather challenges; the UN has repeatedly warned that extreme heat threatens all of society and requires coordinated government action, especially to protect vulnerable groups, ensure safe workplaces, and prepare heat‑protection measures early.
Facing the impacts of climate change on daily life and the economy, Lai stressed that the nation must raise its response capacity and resilience, outlining two pivotal strategies.

First, balancing immediate response with long‑term adaptation to safeguard public health and safety. Extreme heat directly threatens lives, affecting outdoor workers, elderly living alone, children and chronic‑disease patients. As heat extremes become the norm, the government must strengthen cooperation among public and private sectors, across ministries and regions, to build proactive, collaborative heat‑protection mechanisms.

Lai emphasized that the government has already linked more than 10,000 “cooling points” nationwide, offering nearby places for the public to escape the heat. Some participating businesses even post notices at their doors inviting anyone who feels too hot to come in, rest in air‑conditioned comfort, without any purchase required.

In addition, last month the Environmental Protection Administration, together with central, local and medical institutions across 50 entities, completed Taiwan’s first live‑fire drill using a 40 °C extreme‑heat scenario to test heat‑injury rescue, care for vulnerable groups and the response capacity of critical facilities.

Second, strengthening transport system resilience and accelerating the green mobility transition. Taiwan, a densely populated island with concentrated industry, relies on land, sea and air transport not only as the lifeblood of economic development but also as the foundation for societal function and disaster response.

Lai pointed out that in past transport‑disaster events, when eastern rail and road links were cut by natural hazards, the Ministry of Transportation promptly activated maritime backup to maintain essential evacuation and supply flows, demonstrating the importance of integrating transport modes and establishing backup mechanisms.

Lai said the government will use the drill’s findings to further improve heat‑protection and response mechanisms, incorporating them into the Phase‑4 National Climate Adaptation Action Plan. This will comprehensively enhance heat warnings, worker protection, community care and inter‑agency response, and will continue the “National Green Shade Adaptation Strategy” introduced at the 7th meeting in April, prioritizing improvements in heat‑prone, shade‑deficient areas so that natural greenery becomes a protective canopy, creating a more livable and safe environment.

items.title: 國發基金海外融資翻倍至600億元 葉俊顯喊「台灣模式」助半導體出海
items.title_en: National Development Fund Doubles Overseas Financing to NT$60 Billion, Ye Junxian Calls for a “Taiwan Model” to Help Semiconductors Go Global
paras: 國發會主委葉俊顯今（22）日出席勤業眾信半導體高峰會時強調，政府全力支持半導體供應鏈出海，推動「根留台灣、布局全球、行銷世界」的台灣模式。為強化企業海外投資資金後盾，國發基金海外投資融資貸款額度已由300億元翻倍提高至600億元，並搭配「企業投資美國融資保證機制」，打造「大廠領軍、小廠群聚、政府支援」的打群架打法。勤業眾信亦同步發布最新決策指南，指引台商由單純擴產轉向建構跨國生態系合作。
AI與高效能運算（HPC）需求持續爆發，正加速重塑全球半導體產業供應鏈地緣版圖。勤業眾信聯合會計師事務所今（22）日舉辦「2026 Deloitte半導體CxO領袖交流高峰會」，聚焦算力新紀元下的跨國供應鏈重組。
葉俊顯指出，台灣擁有全球最完整的半導體產業生態系，政府將全力推行「根留台灣、布局全球、行銷世界」的「台灣模式」，並宣示國發基金海外投資融資貸款額度已大幅提高至600億元，為台商全球布局提供堅實的金融後盾。
葉俊顯表示，台灣半導體產業在先進製程、先進封裝及矽光子等核心技術上均具備不可替代的領先優勢。面對各國相繼推動在地化供應鏈與再工業化政策，政府全力支持企業結合台灣既有的強大研發與製造能力，積極貼近全球終端客戶及AI應用市場。
為解決供應鏈業者出海時面臨的資金與融資痛點，葉俊顯說明，政府已具體落實「企業投資美國融資保證機制」，同時將國發基金海外投資融資貸款額度由原先的300億元一口氣提高至600億元，倍數成長的資金池將顯著強化半導體中下游供應鏈在海外投資時的金融支援強度。他期盼能透過「大廠領軍、小廠群聚、政府支援」的戰略，結合金融機構與專業顧問團隊，帶領台灣產業建立具備高度協同合作與韌性的全球供應鏈生態系。
勤業眾信總裁柯志賢則於開場致詞時強調，半導體海外布局絕非僅是增加生產據點，更是企業在全球產業分工中角色與資源的重新構建。企業應擺脫過去單純「擴產」的思考模式，從長期競爭策略出發，轉向「跨國生態系合作」。勤業眾信今日也同步發布《台灣半導體企業跨境布局：投資與營運決策指南》，為企業董事會與管理層提供包含選址、模式、稅務、人才、法遵及能源等全方位的評估指引。
勤業眾信高科技、媒體與電信產業負責人簡宏偉進一步提醒，台商出海最大的風險，往往是在尚未釐清所有關鍵變數前，就做出龐大的資源承諾。隨著地緣政治與政策誘因改變，企業應善用「決策檢核表」，採取「先驗證、再承諾」的分階段投入模式，將一次性的海外設點投資，真正轉化為可持續運作的全球營運體系。
與會的受邀嘉賓包括外貿協會董事長黃志芳、鈺創 (5351-TW) 董事長盧超群、德鑫半導體董事長闕聖哲及李長榮先進材料董事長趙繁明等業界領袖，亦一致認同台灣應從傳統的伺服器與晶片供應商角色，升級為整體AI基礎設施的戰略合作夥伴。隨著政策資金600億元到位與專業實務指引到位，台灣半導體產業鏈正全力由在地製造優勢，全面邁向全球生態系整合的新頁章。
paras_en: National Development Council Chairman Ye Junxian attended the Deloitte Semiconductor Summit today (22nd) and stressed that the government fully supports the semiconductor supply chain’s overseas expansion, promoting a “Taiwan model” of “roots in Taiwan, layout globally, market worldwide.” To strengthen financial backing for corporate overseas investment, the National Development Fund’s overseas investment loan quota has been doubled from NT$30 billion to NT$60 billion, complemented by a “Corporate Investment US Financing Guarantee Mechanism,” creating a strategy of “large firms leading, small firms clustering, government support.” Deloitte also released an updated decision‑making guide directing Taiwanese firms to shift from pure capacity expansion to building cross‑border ecosystem collaborations.

Demand for AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) continues to explode, accelerating the reshaping of the global semiconductor supply‑chain geography. Deloitte held the “2026 Deloitte Semiconductor CxO Leadership Summit” today (22nd), focusing on the re‑organization of multinational supply chains in the new era of computing power.

Ye Junxian pointed out that Taiwan possesses the world’s most complete semiconductor ecosystem, and the government will fully implement the “roots in Taiwan, layout globally, market worldwide” Taiwan model, announcing that the National Development Fund’s overseas investment loan quota has been significantly increased to NT$60 billion, providing a solid financial backbone for Taiwanese companies’ global positioning.

Ye Junxian said Taiwan’s semiconductor industry holds irreplaceable leading advantages in advanced processes, advanced packaging, and silicon photonics. Facing various countries’ moves toward localized supply chains and re‑industrialization policies, the government will fully support firms in leveraging Taiwan’s strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities to closely serve global end‑customers and AI application markets.

To address the funding and financing pain points Taiwanese supply‑chain players face when going abroad, Ye explained that the government has concretely implemented the “Corporate Investment US Financing Guarantee Mechanism,” and simultaneously raised the National Development Fund’s overseas investment loan quota from NT$30 billion to NT$60 billion in one step. This multiplied capital pool will markedly strengthen financial support for downstream semiconductor suppliers’ overseas projects. He hopes the “large firms leading, small firms clustering, government support” strategy, combined with financial institutions and professional advisory teams, will help Taiwan’s industry build a highly coordinated and resilient global supply‑chain ecosystem.

Deloitte President Ko Chih‑hsien emphasized in his opening remarks that overseas semiconductor deployment is not merely about adding production sites but about redefining a company’s role and resources in the global industry division of labor. Firms should move beyond the old “capacity‑expansion” mindset and, from a long‑term competitive strategy, shift toward “cross‑border ecosystem cooperation.” Deloitte also released the “Taiwan Semiconductor Companies Cross‑Border Layout: Investment and Operations Decision Guide,” offering boards and management comprehensive evaluation guidance on site selection, business models, tax, talent, compliance, energy and more.

Deloitte’s head of High‑Tech, Media and Telecom, Chien Hong‑wei, warned that the biggest risk for Taiwanese firms going abroad is committing massive resources before all key variables are clarified. As geopolitical and policy incentives evolve, companies should use a “decision checklist” and adopt a “validate first, commit later” phased‑investment approach, turning one‑off overseas site investments into sustainable global operations.

Invited guests included Taiwan External Trade Development Council Chairman Huang Chih‑fang, Yuchuang (5351‑TW) Chairman Lu Chao‑chun, Dexin Semiconductor Chairman Que Sheng‑zhe, and Li‑Chang‑Rong Advanced Materials Chairman Zhao Fan‑ming, among other industry leaders. They unanimously agreed that Taiwan should evolve from a traditional server and chip supplier to a strategic partner for the entire AI infrastructure. With NT$60 billion of policy funding and practical guidance now in place, Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain is poised to transition from local manufacturing strength to a new chapter of global ecosystem integration.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。
英鎊兌美元升值0.05%，至1.3401美元。
澳幣兌美元則下跌0.11%，至0.7019美元。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.
