items.title: 美媒爆川普致電馬斯克 要求解除烏克蘭星鏈限速
items.title_en: U.S. Media Reports Trump Called Musk to Request Lifting Speed Limit on Ukraine’s Starlink
paras: 《華爾街日報》週四 (22 日) 引述美國官員報導，美國總統川普週三 (21 日) 致電 SpaceX 執行長馬斯克，要求解除對烏克蘭軍用版星鏈 (Starlink) 的限速措施。美烏官員表示，通話後，系統運作已於週四改善，但尚未完全恢復正常。
該報引述知情官員透露，川普在通話中對系統仍設有每小時約 100 英里 (約 161 公里) 的移動速度上限表達不滿。這項限制使部分烏克蘭攻擊無人機及攔截無人機在高速飛行時，無法持續連上衛星網路，削弱烏軍打擊目標及抵禦俄軍攻勢的能力。
報導指出，川普本週已向幕僚及盟友表示，希望撤銷限速措施。部分烏方官員指出，目前設備已能在超過先前速度上限的情況下維持連線，但系統功能仍未完全恢復。
川普稍晚被問及是否曾致電馬斯克時，未正面證實，僅表示：「不管是我打的，還是其他人打的 (電話)，都沒有差別，重點是他已經恢復服務了。」他當時正離開白宮，準備前往愛荷華州參加競選造勢活動。
隨著連線狀況改善，限速決策的責任歸屬仍有待釐清。
白宮援引川普近期說法，重申川普否認要求馬斯克限速，也不知道由誰下令。
《華爾街日報》先前報導，馬斯克曾下令對烏克蘭使用的軍用版星鏈實施限速，但 SpaceX 與白宮對於他是自行決定，還是應政府要求採取行動，說法並不一致。川普則多次否認曾下令限速，也表示不知道是誰下達指令。
美國政府高層對馬斯克在此事中的角色，也有不同表態。
副總統范斯週四向記者表示，馬斯克不希望在缺乏美國政府明確指引的情況下捲入戰爭，是完全可以理解的。他認為，問題的核心在於美國對烏克蘭與俄羅斯的政策方向。
國防部長赫格塞斯與國務卿盧比歐先前則表示，馬斯克有權依據公司服務條款採取行動，無須政府介入。赫格塞斯本週稍早指出，使用者必須遵守服務條款，星鏈可據此做出相關決定。
限速措施實施前幾天，川普與馬斯克均曾公開批評烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基攻擊俄羅斯柴油煉油廠，川普並將能源價格上漲歸咎於這些攻擊。星鏈連線問題也使美烏關係降至數月來低點。
這起事件也引發國會關注。跨黨派參議員 15 日已聯名要求國防部監察長調查星盾服務中斷，釐清美國官員是否批准或事先知情。
美國民主黨籍參議員Richard Blumenthal 週四宣布展開調查，將釐清烏克蘭星鏈服務為何在未事先通知的情況下遭到限制，並檢視五角大廈依賴 SpaceX 提供關鍵衛星通訊所帶來的影響。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that, citing U.S. officials, President Donald Trump called SpaceX CEO Elon Musk on Wednesday (the 21st) and asked to lift the speed‑limit imposed on the military‑grade Starlink used by Ukraine. Ukrainian and U.S. officials said the system’s performance improved on Thursday after the call, but it has not fully returned to normal.

The paper quoted informed officials who said Trump expressed dissatisfaction that the system still had a movement‑speed cap of about 100 miles per hour (roughly 161 km/h). The limit prevented some Ukrainian attack drones and interceptor drones from staying connected to the satellite network during high‑speed flight, weakening the Ukrainian forces’ ability to strike targets and repel Russian offensives.

The report noted that Trump has told his staff and allies this week that he wants the speed‑limit removed. Some Ukrainian officials said the equipment can now stay connected even when exceeding the previous speed cap, but the system’s functionality has not been completely restored.

When later asked whether he had indeed called Musk, Trump did not give a direct confirmation, saying only, “It doesn’t matter who made the call, the point is the service has been restored.” He made the remark as he was leaving the White House to head to Iowa for a campaign rally.
With the connection situation improving, the responsibility for the speed‑limit decision remains to be clarified.
The White House, citing Trump’s recent statements, reiterated that Trump denies ordering Musk to impose a speed limit and says he does not know who gave the order.

The Wall Street Journal previously reported that Musk had ordered a speed‑limit on the military‑grade Starlink used by Ukraine, but SpaceX and the White House gave conflicting accounts on whether he acted on his own or at government request. Trump has repeatedly denied issuing such an order and says he does not know who did.
Senior U.S. officials have also offered differing statements about Musk’s role in the matter.

Vice President Kamala Harris told reporters on Thursday that it is understandable that Musk does not want to become embroiled in a war without clear guidance from the U.S. government. She said the core issue is the United States’ policy direction toward Ukraine and Russia.

Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin and Secretary of State Antony Blinken earlier said Musk is free to act under his company’s service terms and does not need government intervention. Austin earlier this week emphasized that users must comply with the service terms, and Starlink can make decisions accordingly.

In the days before the speed‑limit was imposed, both Trump and Musk publicly criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky’s attacks on Russian diesel refineries, with Trump blaming rising energy prices on those attacks. The Starlink connectivity issue also pushed U.S.–Ukraine relations to a low point not seen in months.

The episode has drawn congressional attention. On the 15th, a bipartisan group of senators jointly urged the Department of Defense’s inspector general to investigate the Starshield service disruption and determine whether U.S. officials approved or were aware of it beforehand.

Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal announced on Thursday that he will launch an investigation to find out why Ukraine’s Starlink service was restricted without prior notice and to examine the Pentagon’s reliance on SpaceX for critical satellite communications.

items.title: Meta崩跌近7% 自由現金流轉負、CDS利差升至歷史新高
items.title_en: Meta crashes nearly 7% as free cash flow turns negative, CDS spread hits historic high
paras: Meta (META-US) 週四 (22 日) 股價重挫近 7% 至每股 648.85 美元。儘管第 3 季營收優於市場預期，但自由現金流轉負，加上公司上調全年資本支出預估下限，引發投資人對人工智慧 (AI) 投資規模與資金需求的擔憂。
《CNBC》報導，Meta 的 5 年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差週四升至歷史新高，顯示隨著公司持續擴大 AI 支出，投資人對其信用風險的疑慮升溫。CDS 是用於對沖債務違約風險的金融工具，利差擴大通常反映信用保障成本上升。
Meta 預估，全年資本支出將介於 1,350 億至 1,450 億美元，將原先 1,300 億美元的區間下限提高 50 億美元，上限則維持不變。
公司第 3 季自由現金流為負 21.2 億美元，龐大投資對現金流的壓力成為市場關注焦點。
相較之下，核心業務營收仍維持成長。Meta 第 3 季營收年增 26%，達 646 億美元，高於分析師預估的 633.7 億美元。每股盈餘為 3.83 美元，但分析指出，尚不清楚這項數字能否直接與華爾街預估的 5.75 美元相比。
除了支出與現金流，Meta 週三公布財報時也揭露，將設立不具投票權的 C 類普通股，藉此維持「創辦人主導」的治理架構，並提高公司為未來成長籌資的彈性。
根據提交美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 的文件，若「加州財富稅」通過，執行長祖克柏可能因持有 Meta 股票，面臨數十億美元的稅款，並可能因此遷離加州。文件指出，新的股票方案促使祖克柏決定留在加州。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) saw its stock plunge almost 7% on Thursday (the 22nd) to $648.85 per share. Although third‑quarter revenue beat market expectations, free cash flow turned negative and the company raised the lower bound of its full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook, sparking investor worries about the scale and funding needs of its artificial‑intelligence investments.

CNBC reported that Meta’s five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) spread jumped to a historic high on Thursday, indicating that as the company continues to ramp up AI spending, investors’ concerns about its credit risk are intensifying. A CDS is a financial instrument used to hedge debt‑default risk, and a widening spread typically reflects higher costs for credit protection.

Meta now expects full‑year capital expenditures to be between $135 billion and $145 billion, lifting the lower end of the prior $130 billion range by $5 billion while keeping the upper limit unchanged.
The company posted a negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion for the third quarter, and the heavy investment pressure on cash flow has become a focal point for the market.

By contrast, core‑business revenue continued to grow. Meta’s third‑quarter revenue rose 26% year‑over‑year to $64.6 billion, beating analysts’ estimate of $63.37 billion. Earnings per share were $3.83, though analysts noted it is unclear how this figure compares directly with Wall Street’s forecast of $5.75 per share.

In addition to spending and cash‑flow issues, Meta disclosed on Wednesday that it will create a non‑voting Class C common‑stock series to preserve a “founder‑led” governance structure and increase the company’s flexibility to raise capital for future growth.

According to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), if a “California wealth tax” is enacted, CEO Mark Zuckerberg could face billions of dollars in taxes on his Meta holdings and might consider leaving California. The filing noted that the new stock plan is intended to encourage Zuckerberg to stay in the state.

items.title: 馬斯克砸10億美元進軍好萊塢？傳入股Skydance
items.title_en: Elon Musk Pours $1 Billion into Hollywood? Stake in Skydance
paras: 據《Semafor》周四(22日)報導，馬斯克已向Skydance(SKYD-US)投資約10億美元，這筆注資是該公司擴大股權募資計畫的一部分。Skydance剛完成大型媒體併購，正推動業務整合與成本削減，同時面臨近800億美元的債務負擔。消息傳出後，股價下跌約1%。
派拉蒙已於10月6日完成收購華納兄弟探索，合併後公司更名為Skydance，股票代號也改為SKYD。sec.gov共同執行長David Ellison與Ynon Kreiz目前肩負整合任務，涵蓋派拉蒙與華納兄弟兩大電影製片廠、Paramount+與HBO Max兩個串流平台，以及支援旗下電視頻道與兩個新聞部門的企業職能。
Skydance先前表示，預計在三年內實現60億美元的成本節省。不過，合併後近800億美元的債務，也使公司在整合業務之際，面臨沉重財務負擔。
《Semafor》指出，馬斯克的投資承諾屬於Skydance尋求股權資金的更廣泛行動。截至報導發布，馬斯克與Skydance代表均未立即回應《CNBC》的置評請求。
馬斯克與Ellison家族過去已有多次投資往來。David Ellison的父親、甲骨文(ORCL-US)共同創辦人Larry Ellison，曾在馬斯克2022年收購Twitter、也就是如今的X時，投入10億美元。
Larry Ellison也曾於2018年投資特斯拉(TSLA-US)，並擔任該公司董事。在派拉蒙收購華納兄弟探索的交易中，他更親自為逾400億美元的股權融資提供擔保。
paras_en: According to Semafor on Thursday (the 22nd), Elon Musk has invested roughly $1 billion in Skydance (SKYD‑US). The capital injection is part of the company’s expanded equity‑raising plan. Skydance has just completed a large media merger and is pushing business integration and cost cuts while carrying about $80 billion of debt. The news sent the stock down about 1 %.

Paramount completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on Oct. 6, and the combined company was renamed Skydance, with the ticker changing to SKYD. Co‑CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz are now tasked with integrating the two major film studios—Paramount and Warner Bros.—as well as the Paramount+ and HBO Max streaming platforms, plus the corporate functions that support the TV channels and two news divisions.

Skydance previously said it expects to achieve $6 billion in cost savings over three years. However, the post‑merger debt load of nearly $80 billion also leaves the company with a heavy financial burden as it works to integrate the businesses.

Semafor noted that Musk’s investment pledge is part of a broader effort by Skydance to raise equity capital. As of the time of the report, neither Musk nor Skydance representatives had responded to CNBC’s request for comment.

Musk and the Ellison family have a history of multiple investments together. David Ellison’s father, Oracle co‑founder Larry Ellison, put $1 billion into Musk’s 2022 acquisition of Twitter, now rebranded as X.
Larry Ellison also invested in Tesla (TSLA‑US) in 2018 and served on its board. In the Paramount‑Warner Bros. Discovery deal, he personally guaranteed more than $40 billion of equity financing.

items.title: 買公債就有高收益！投資人還願意押注生技股嗎？
items.title_en: High Yields from Government Bonds! Are Investors Still Willing to Bet on Biotech Stocks?
paras: 美國公債殖利率快速攀升，正削弱高風險生技股的吸引力。對許多尚未獲利、押注突破性療法的業者而言，投資結果可能是巨額回報，也可能近乎歸零。當相對安全的公債提供更高收益，投資人開始重新衡量承擔新藥研發風險是否值得。
據《彭博》報導，那斯達克生技指數自8月19日高點回落3.8%，同期美國10年期公債殖利率攀升近0.5個百分點，一度觸及5.34%，創2002年以來最高。該指數涵蓋近250家生技公司，今年仍上漲約25%，但近期回檔已反映利率壓力。

公債收益提高 生技業融資與現金壓力加劇

White Manna Capital創辦人暨投資長William Soliman指出，投資人如今有收益更高的無風險替代選項，使早期生技公司的投資吸引力面臨挑戰。對距離創造營收可能還有數年的企業，投資人將要求更高的風險溢價，才願意承擔臨床、監管與融資風險。
能源價格飆升與企業大舉借款投入AI，推動美債殖利率走高，也凸顯市場擔心通膨持續，讓原本資金吃緊的生技業處境更艱難。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，那斯達克生技指數成分股中，過去一年獲利者不到四分之一，約半數公司的現金不足以支應六個月日常開銷。高利率進一步提高資金成本與再融資風險。

新藥成果仍有吸引力 資金回流卻添阻力

儘管如此，Gabelli基金經理人Elena Meng仍看好生技業長期前景，表示投資流程原本就會評估估值、資金成本與現金能支撐多久，利率變動不會根本改變其策略。
今年部分業者也交出亮眼成果。Moderna(MRNA-US)與默沙東(MRK-US)治療黑色素瘤的正面試驗數據，帶動Moderna股價在連跌四年後，今年大漲逾700%。Revolution Medicines(RVMD-US)延長晚期胰臟癌患者壽命的口服藥獲美國核准，股價今年上漲逾140%。
RBC Capital Markets分析師則認為，若AI行情退燒，生技股可望受惠於資金從科技股轉出。不過，Baird醫療產業專家Mike Perrone提醒，臨床試驗結果仍左右股價，幾家大型業者若傳出壞消息，就可能打擊市場熱情。
基因編輯業者Caribou Biosciences(CRBU-US)本月宣布終止兩項療法計畫，評估合併或被收購等選項，並規劃裁員與削減成本，今年股價已跌逾60%。Perrone指出，高利率這項明確逆風，將讓重視總體環境的跨產業投資人，對重返生技股更加猶豫。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields are climbing rapidly, eroding the appeal of high‑risk biotech stocks. For many unprofitable firms betting on breakthrough therapies, the payoff could be massive or near zero. When relatively safe Treasuries offer higher returns, investors begin to reassess whether the risk of new‑drug development is worth it.

According to Bloomberg, the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index fell 3.8% from its August 19 peak as the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose nearly 0.5 percentage points, briefly hitting 5.34% – the highest level since 2002. The index, which covers about 250 biotech companies, is up roughly 25% year‑to‑date, but the recent pullback reflects pressure from rising rates.

Higher bond yields tighten financing and cash conditions for biotech. William Soliman, founder and CIO of White Manna Capital, said investors now have a higher‑yielding, risk‑free alternative, challenging the attractiveness of early‑stage biotech investments. For companies that may not generate revenue for years, investors will demand a larger risk premium to take on clinical, regulatory and financing risk.

Surging energy prices and massive corporate borrowing to fund AI have pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, underscoring market worries about persistent inflation and making an already cash‑constrained biotech sector even tougher.

Bloomberg’s data show that less than a quarter of Nasdaq Biotechnology Index constituents were profitable over the past year, and about half lack enough cash to cover six months of operating expenses. High rates further raise capital costs and refinancing risk.

Despite this, Gabelli fund manager Elena Meng remains bullish on the long‑term outlook for biotech, noting that investment decisions already factor valuation, cost of capital and cash runway, and that interest‑rate moves do not fundamentally alter the strategy.

Some companies have delivered standout results this year. Moderna (MRNA‑US) and Merck (MRK‑US) posted positive trial data for melanoma treatments, sending Moderna’s stock soaring more than 700% after four years of decline. Revolution Medicines (RVMD‑US) received U.S. approval for an oral drug that extends survival in late‑stage pancreatic cancer, lifting its share price over 140% this year.

RBC Capital Markets analysts argue that if the AI rally cools, biotech could benefit from capital rotating out of tech stocks. However, Baird healthcare expert Mike Perrone cautions that clinical trial outcomes still drive stock prices, and negative news from a few large players could dampen market enthusiasm.

Gene‑editing firm Caribou Biosciences (CRBU‑US) announced this month that it is terminating two therapy programs, evaluating merger or acquisition options, and planning layoffs and cost cuts; its stock has already fallen more than 60% this year. Perrone notes that high rates are a clear headwind, making cross‑industry investors who consider the broader environment more hesitant to return to biotech stocks.

items.title: 美光投資思維該轉變了？分析師：AI記憶體需求是場馬拉松
items.title_en: Is Micron's Investment Thinking Due for a Shift? Analyst Says AI Memory Demand Is a Marathon
paras: 美光(MU-US)近期股價疲弱，反映投資人再度質疑人工智慧(AI)支出的持久性。根據《MarketWatch》訪調的多名分析師，市場對美光的期待可能需要調整：記憶體市場的成長未必很快觸頂，投資人應把眼光放得更長遠，將AI需求視為一場馬拉松，而非短跑。
Stifel分析師Brian Chin表示，雖然近期引發跌勢的疑慮並非美光獨有，但仍讓投資人思考，究竟什麼因素才能重新帶動這檔指標性AI概念股上漲。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson則說，若需求放緩，記憶體受到的衝擊可能比其他零組件更大，因為「問題不只是銷量或出貨量，最終還會演變成價格問題」。換言之，美光及其他記憶體供應商目前能夠收取高價，是因為需求強勁，一旦市場環境轉弱，客戶就不願再支付如此高的價格。
考量到AI泡沫不太可能立即破裂，在市場焦慮升高、基本面卻尚未出現太大變化之際，分析師會如何建議客戶應對？

記憶體市場成長還能持續多久？低本益比提供一定支撐

《MarketWatch》指出，首先值得思考的是，記憶體市場的高速成長還能持續多久。部分投資人擔心，需求可能在兩季後出現負面轉折，但Chin表示，實際情況可能是兩到三年後才發生。
他補充，只要強勁的市場環境能夠維持這麼久，美光EPS就可能遠高於目前水準。不過，Chin不認為美光的本益比會大幅攀升，目前股價約為他預估未來EPS的五倍。
從正面來看，美光目前的本益比相當低，進一步壓縮的空間有限。Chin表示，只要獲利至少能緩步成長，這項特性就能讓美光股價「具有一定的防禦性」。
Gabelli Funds分析師Ryuta Makino表示，從相對估值來看，美光具備吸引力，尤其與儲存類股相比，美光股價的估值倍數較低。

供給擴張受限 供應鏈瓶頸恐減緩產能成長

除了需求放緩，投資人還必須留意市場供給。如果美光或競爭對手增加的供給過多，可能削弱整個產業維持記憶體高價的能力，而目前各家業者都已有擴充產能的計畫。
不過，Chin指出，半導體設備製造商目前難以迅速提高晶片製造設備的供應，因此「供應鏈的摩擦將限制供給成長速度」。
他認為，記憶體市場的投資邏輯正從短跑轉向長距離馬拉松，「現階段投資美光，需要的就是這種心態。」

AI融資風險成壓力 但記憶體供需仍趨緊

接下來是融資問題。美光的現金部位持續增加，但部分AI晶片買家愈來愈依賴借貸資金，支撐整個AI生態系的運作。Makino表示，市場對AI相關投資債務不斷攀升的疑慮，正在拖累美光股價。
他指出，前沿AI研究機構與新一代雲端服務供應商的自由現金流均為負值，在此同時，記憶體價格上漲正在推升資料中心伺服器價格，「進一步加劇融資風險」。
儘管如此，Makino表示，目前供需狀況依然吃緊，他預期明年到2028年，供需還會進一步收緊。
整體而言，Bryson並未看到需求放緩的跡象，但預期記憶體相關交易仍將持續波動。
美光股價周三早盤走勢震盪，一度上漲3.6%，隨後短暫轉跌，終場上漲約2%至每股913.67美元。美光目前股價以從6月高點下跌26%，但今年來仍上漲逾三倍。
Bryson說：「運算產業的歷史告訴我們，支援各種應用需要更多記憶體。如果你相信未來會有更多AI應用，就代表需要更多記憶體來支援這些應用。」
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) has seen weak recent stock performance, reflecting renewed investor doubts about the durability of AI spending. According to multiple analysts surveyed by MarketWatch, expectations for Micron may need to be adjusted: memory market growth may not peak quickly, and investors should take a longer view, treating AI demand as a marathon rather than a sprint.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin noted that while the recent concerns driving the decline are not unique to Micron, they still prompt investors to consider what factors could reignite this flagship AI‑themed stock.

Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson added that if demand eases, memory could feel the impact more than other components because “the issue isn’t just volume or shipments; it ultimately becomes a pricing problem.” In other words, Micron and other memory suppliers can command high prices now because demand is strong, but customers will balk at paying those premiums if the market softens.
Given that an AI bubble is unlikely to burst immediately, how will analysts advise clients to respond amid rising market anxiety but still‑stable fundamentals?

How long can memory market growth continue? Low P/E provides some support. MarketWatch points out that the first question is how long the rapid growth in memory can be sustained. Some investors fear a negative turn in demand two quarters out, but Chin says the reality may not materialize until two to three years later.

He added that if a strong market environment can be maintained that long, Micron’s EPS could be far above current levels. However, Chin does not expect Micron’s price‑to‑earnings ratio to climb dramatically; the current share price is about five times his projected future EPS.

On the positive side, Micron’s P/E is currently quite low, leaving limited room for further compression. Chin says that as long as earnings can at least grow modestly, this characteristic gives Micron’s stock “a certain defensive quality.”
Gabelli Funds analyst Ryuta Makino said that on a relative‑valuation basis, Micron is attractive, especially compared with storage‑focused stocks, where Micron’s valuation multiple is lower.

Supply expansion is constrained; supply‑chain bottlenecks may slow capacity growth. In addition to demand slowdown, investors must watch market supply. If Micron or rivals add too much capacity, it could weaken the industry’s ability to sustain high memory prices, and all players already have expansion plans underway.
However, Chin points out that semiconductor equipment makers cannot quickly ramp up chip‑making equipment supply, so “supply‑chain friction will limit the speed of supply growth.”
He believes the investment logic for memory is shifting from a sprint to a long‑distance marathon, and “investing in Micron at this stage requires that mindset.”

AI financing risk is a pressure point, but memory supply‑and‑demand remains tight. Micron’s cash balance continues to grow, yet some AI chip buyers are increasingly reliant on borrowed funds to sustain the AI ecosystem. Makino says market worries about rising AI‑related investment debt are weighing on Micron’s share price.

He noted that leading AI research institutions and next‑generation cloud service providers are posting negative free cash flow, while rising memory prices are pushing up data‑center server prices, “further aggravating financing risk.”
Nevertheless, Makino says the current supply‑demand balance is still tight, and he expects it to tighten further from next year through 2028.
Overall, Bryson does not see signs of demand slowing, but expects memory‑related transactions to remain volatile.

Micron’s stock was volatile in early Wednesday trade, briefly rising 3.6% before a short dip, and closed up about 2% at $913.67 per share. The stock is down 26% from its June peak but has more than tripled year‑to‑date.

Bryson said: “History of the computing industry tells us that supporting a variety of applications requires more memory. If you believe there will be more AI applications in the future, that means more memory will be needed to support those applications.”

items.title: AI疑慮與戰火風險升溫！資金轉抱美債 10年期殖利率跌破5%
items.title_en: AI Concerns and War Risks Heat Up! Funds Shift to U.S. Treasuries as 10-Year Yield Falls Below 5%
paras: 美國公債殖利率周四(22日)大幅下滑，10年期殖利率跌破5%，為近一個月來首見。市場對人工智慧(AI)投資前景的疑慮，加上中東緊張局勢推升油價，引發股市重挫，促使投資人轉向公債避險。
美國10年期公債殖利率下跌15個基點至4.996%，為9月23日以來首次低於5%。這項指標是房貸等長期借貸成本的重要參考，其回落反映避險買盤推升公債價格。
對聯準會(Fed)短期利率政策較敏感的2年期公債殖利率，下跌14個基點至4.69%；30年期公債殖利率則下跌10個基點至5.32%。公債價格與殖利率呈反向變動，每個基點相當於0.01個百分點。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳周四接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，新型雲端業者的需求雖然「強勁到爆表」，但資金仍然短缺。這番談話讓AI基礎設施擴張所面臨的資金瓶頸再度受到關注，相關疑慮也使股市承壓。
中東局勢升溫則進一步加劇市場避險情緒。《紐約時報》引述匿名美國官員報導，美國與以色列正考慮在下月美國期中選舉後，恢復對伊朗發動攻擊，採取一場「短暫但密集」的軍事行動。
消息推升國際油價。西德州中質原油(WTI)期貨周四早盤上漲逾2%，站上每桶99美元、逼近100美元；全球基準布蘭特原油也上漲逾2%，突破每桶111美元。
在AI投資疑慮與地緣政治風險夾擊下，資金撤出股票、轉向公債，帶動美債殖利率明顯回落。
持續更新...
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields fell sharply on Thursday (the 22nd), with the 10-year yield slipping below 5% for the first time in about a month. Doubts about the outlook for AI investments, combined with rising oil prices due to Middle‑East tensions, triggered a steep equity sell‑off and pushed investors toward Treasury safe havens.

The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield dropped 15 basis points to 4.996%, marking the first time since September 23 that it fell below 5%. This benchmark is a key reference for long‑term borrowing costs such as mortgages, and its decline reflects safe‑haven buying that lifted Treasury prices.

The 2-year Treasury yield, which is more sensitive to the Fed’s short‑term rate policy, fell 14 basis points to 4.69%, while the 30-year yield slipped 10 basis points to 5.32%. Treasury prices move inversely to yields, with each basis point equal to 0.01 percentage point.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC on Thursday that demand from new cloud providers is "off the charts," yet funding remains tight. His comments revived focus on the financing bottleneck facing AI infrastructure expansion, adding to the market’s pressure.

Escalating tensions in the Middle East further heightened safe‑haven sentiment. The New York Times, citing an anonymous U.S. official, reported that the United States and Israel are considering a "short but intense" military action against Iran after next month’s U.S. midterm elections.

The news pushed international oil prices higher. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures rose more than 2% in early Thursday trade, breaking above $99 a barrel and nearing $100, while the global benchmark Brent crude also climbed over 2% to surpass $111 a barrel.
Faced with AI investment doubts and geopolitical risk, money fled equities and moved into Treasuries, driving a noticeable pull‑back in U.S. bond yields.
Continuously updating...

items.title: AI愈砸錢債市愈不安！Meta信用風險指標創新高
items.title_en: AI Spending Fuels Bond Market Unease! Meta Credit Risk Indicator Hits New High
paras: Meta(META-US)擴大資本支出計畫，再度引發市場對科技巨頭舉債投入人工智慧(AI)建設的疑慮。公司信用風險指標周四(22日)盤中升至歷史新高，債券也走弱，反映投資人擔心，在債券供給已相當充裕的市場中，科技業可能進一步增加發債規模。
根據ICE Data Services數據，Meta五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價盤中最多上升8.9個基點，至約119.3個基點，創這類合約約一年前開始活躍交易以來最高。CDS可用於對沖債務違約風險，報價上升代表投資人為債務購買保障的成本增加。
這波信用風險疑慮也波及其他大型雲端與晶片業者，甲骨文(ORCL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)及博通(AVGO-US)的CDS報價同日均上揚。
Meta揭露，已承諾未來為各類租賃與合約支出約8250億美元，其中許多涉及AI運算能力與基礎設施，高於7月公布的近7000億美元。這些承諾涵蓋未來不同期間，並非單一年度支出。
公司也將今年資本支出預估區間下限，由1300億美元提高至1350億美元，上限維持1450億美元，但未提供明年的資本支出指引。
與此同時，Meta第三季自由現金流轉為負21.2億美元，相較之下，第二季為正7.84億美元，去年第三季則為正106.25億美元，顯示公司在大規模投資下，現金流狀況明顯轉弱。
除了CDS報價攀升，Meta公司債相對美國公債的表現也轉弱。根據Trace數據，其2036年到期、票面利率5.25%的債券，風險溢價擴大6個基點至1.2個百分點，亦即投資人要求的殖利率較美國公債高出約120個基點，才願意持有這筆債券。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is expanding its capital‑expenditure plan, reigniting market concerns about tech giants borrowing heavily to fund artificial‑intelligence (AI) projects. The company’s credit‑risk metric rose to a historic high during Thursday’s (22nd) trading, and its bonds weakened, reflecting investor worries that, in a market already flush with bond supply, the tech sector may further increase its issuance volume.

According to ICE Data Services, Meta’s five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) price rose up to 8.9 basis points intraday, reaching about 119.3 basis points – the highest level since these contracts began trading actively roughly a year ago. CDS contracts are used to hedge debt‑default risk, and a higher price means the cost of buying protection against the debt has increased.
The credit‑risk concerns also spread to other large cloud and semiconductor players, with CDS spreads for Oracle (ORCL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) all climbing on the same day.

Meta disclosed that it has pledged roughly $825 billion in future lease and contract commitments, many tied to AI computing power and infrastructure, up from the nearly $700 billion announced in July. These commitments span multiple future periods and are not confined to a single fiscal year.

The company also raised the lower bound of its 2024 capital‑expenditure outlook from $130 billion to $135 billion, keeping the upper bound at $145 billion, while providing no guidance for next year’s cap‑ex.

Meanwhile, Meta’s free cash flow turned negative $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with a positive $784 million in the second quarter and a positive $10.625 billion in the same quarter last year, indicating a marked weakening of cash‑flow conditions amid massive investment.

In addition to rising CDS spreads, Meta’s corporate bonds have underperformed relative to U.S. Treasuries. Trace data show that the 2036‑maturity bond with a 5.25% coupon saw its risk premium widen by six basis points to 1.2 percentage points, meaning investors now demand a yield roughly 120 basis points above the U.S. Treasury to hold the bond.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.

items.title: 美媒爆川普致電馬斯克 要求解除烏克蘭星鏈限速
items.title_en: U.S. Media Reports Trump Called Musk to Request Lifting Speed Limit on Ukraine’s Starlink
paras: 《華爾街日報》週四 (22 日) 引述美國官員報導，美國總統川普週三 (21 日) 致電 SpaceX 執行長馬斯克，要求解除對烏克蘭軍用版星鏈 (Starlink) 的限速措施。美烏官員表示，通話後，系統運作已於週四改善，但尚未完全恢復正常。
該報引述知情官員透露，川普在通話中對系統仍設有每小時約 100 英里 (約 161 公里) 的移動速度上限表達不滿。這項限制使部分烏克蘭攻擊無人機及攔截無人機在高速飛行時，無法持續連上衛星網路，削弱烏軍打擊目標及抵禦俄軍攻勢的能力。
報導指出，川普本週已向幕僚及盟友表示，希望撤銷限速措施。部分烏方官員指出，目前設備已能在超過先前速度上限的情況下維持連線，但系統功能仍未完全恢復。
川普稍晚被問及是否曾致電馬斯克時，未正面證實，僅表示：「不管是我打的，還是其他人打的 (電話)，都沒有差別，重點是他已經恢復服務了。」他當時正離開白宮，準備前往愛荷華州參加競選造勢活動。
隨著連線狀況改善，限速決策的責任歸屬仍有待釐清。
白宮援引川普近期說法，重申川普否認要求馬斯克限速，也不知道由誰下令。
《華爾街日報》先前報導，馬斯克曾下令對烏克蘭使用的軍用版星鏈實施限速，但 SpaceX 與白宮對於他是自行決定，還是應政府要求採取行動，說法並不一致。川普則多次否認曾下令限速，也表示不知道是誰下達指令。
美國政府高層對馬斯克在此事中的角色，也有不同表態。
副總統范斯週四向記者表示，馬斯克不希望在缺乏美國政府明確指引的情況下捲入戰爭，是完全可以理解的。他認為，問題的核心在於美國對烏克蘭與俄羅斯的政策方向。
國防部長赫格塞斯與國務卿盧比歐先前則表示，馬斯克有權依據公司服務條款採取行動，無須政府介入。赫格塞斯本週稍早指出，使用者必須遵守服務條款，星鏈可據此做出相關決定。
限速措施實施前幾天，川普與馬斯克均曾公開批評烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基攻擊俄羅斯柴油煉油廠，川普並將能源價格上漲歸咎於這些攻擊。星鏈連線問題也使美烏關係降至數月來低點。
這起事件也引發國會關注。跨黨派參議員 15 日已聯名要求國防部監察長調查星盾服務中斷，釐清美國官員是否批准或事先知情。
美國民主黨籍參議員Richard Blumenthal 週四宣布展開調查，將釐清烏克蘭星鏈服務為何在未事先通知的情況下遭到限制，並檢視五角大廈依賴 SpaceX 提供關鍵衛星通訊所帶來的影響。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that, citing U.S. officials, President Donald Trump called SpaceX CEO Elon Musk on Wednesday (the 21st) and asked to lift the speed‑limit imposed on the military‑grade Starlink used by Ukraine. Ukrainian and U.S. officials said the system’s performance improved on Thursday after the call, but it has not fully returned to normal.

The paper quoted informed officials who said Trump expressed dissatisfaction that the system still had a movement‑speed cap of about 100 miles per hour (roughly 161 km/h). The limit prevented some Ukrainian attack drones and interceptor drones from staying connected to the satellite network during high‑speed flight, weakening the Ukrainian forces’ ability to strike targets and repel Russian offensives.

The report noted that Trump has told his staff and allies this week that he wants the speed‑limit removed. Some Ukrainian officials said the equipment can now stay connected even when exceeding the previous speed cap, but the system’s functionality has not been completely restored.

When later asked whether he had indeed called Musk, Trump did not give a direct confirmation, saying only, “It doesn’t matter who made the call, the point is the service has been restored.” He made the remark as he was leaving the White House to head to Iowa for a campaign rally.
With the connection situation improving, the responsibility for the speed‑limit decision remains to be clarified.
The White House, citing Trump’s recent statements, reiterated that Trump denies ordering Musk to impose a speed limit and says he does not know who gave the order.

The Wall Street Journal previously reported that Musk had ordered a speed‑limit on the military‑grade Starlink used by Ukraine, but SpaceX and the White House gave conflicting accounts on whether he acted on his own or at government request. Trump has repeatedly denied issuing such an order and says he does not know who did.
Senior U.S. officials have also offered differing statements about Musk’s role in the matter.

Vice President Kamala Harris told reporters on Thursday that it is understandable that Musk does not want to become embroiled in a war without clear guidance from the U.S. government. She said the core issue is the United States’ policy direction toward Ukraine and Russia.

Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin and Secretary of State Antony Blinken earlier said Musk is free to act under his company’s service terms and does not need government intervention. Austin earlier this week emphasized that users must comply with the service terms, and Starlink can make decisions accordingly.

In the days before the speed‑limit was imposed, both Trump and Musk publicly criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky’s attacks on Russian diesel refineries, with Trump blaming rising energy prices on those attacks. The Starlink connectivity issue also pushed U.S.–Ukraine relations to a low point not seen in months.

The episode has drawn congressional attention. On the 15th, a bipartisan group of senators jointly urged the Department of Defense’s inspector general to investigate the Starshield service disruption and determine whether U.S. officials approved or were aware of it beforehand.

Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal announced on Thursday that he will launch an investigation to find out why Ukraine’s Starlink service was restricted without prior notice and to examine the Pentagon’s reliance on SpaceX for critical satellite communications.

items.title: Meta崩跌近7% 自由現金流轉負、CDS利差升至歷史新高
items.title_en: Meta crashes nearly 7% as free cash flow turns negative, CDS spread hits historic high
paras: Meta (META-US) 週四 (22 日) 股價重挫近 7% 至每股 648.85 美元。儘管第 3 季營收優於市場預期，但自由現金流轉負，加上公司上調全年資本支出預估下限，引發投資人對人工智慧 (AI) 投資規模與資金需求的擔憂。
《CNBC》報導，Meta 的 5 年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差週四升至歷史新高，顯示隨著公司持續擴大 AI 支出，投資人對其信用風險的疑慮升溫。CDS 是用於對沖債務違約風險的金融工具，利差擴大通常反映信用保障成本上升。
Meta 預估，全年資本支出將介於 1,350 億至 1,450 億美元，將原先 1,300 億美元的區間下限提高 50 億美元，上限則維持不變。
公司第 3 季自由現金流為負 21.2 億美元，龐大投資對現金流的壓力成為市場關注焦點。
相較之下，核心業務營收仍維持成長。Meta 第 3 季營收年增 26%，達 646 億美元，高於分析師預估的 633.7 億美元。每股盈餘為 3.83 美元，但分析指出，尚不清楚這項數字能否直接與華爾街預估的 5.75 美元相比。
除了支出與現金流，Meta 週三公布財報時也揭露，將設立不具投票權的 C 類普通股，藉此維持「創辦人主導」的治理架構，並提高公司為未來成長籌資的彈性。
根據提交美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 的文件，若「加州財富稅」通過，執行長祖克柏可能因持有 Meta 股票，面臨數十億美元的稅款，並可能因此遷離加州。文件指出，新的股票方案促使祖克柏決定留在加州。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) saw its stock plunge almost 7% on Thursday (the 22nd) to $648.85 per share. Although third‑quarter revenue beat market expectations, free cash flow turned negative and the company raised the lower bound of its full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook, sparking investor worries about the scale and funding needs of its artificial‑intelligence investments.

CNBC reported that Meta’s five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) spread jumped to a historic high on Thursday, indicating that as the company continues to ramp up AI spending, investors’ concerns about its credit risk are intensifying. A CDS is a financial instrument used to hedge debt‑default risk, and a widening spread typically reflects higher costs for credit protection.

Meta now expects full‑year capital expenditures to be between $135 billion and $145 billion, lifting the lower end of the prior $130 billion range by $5 billion while keeping the upper limit unchanged.
The company posted a negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion for the third quarter, and the heavy investment pressure on cash flow has become a focal point for the market.

By contrast, core‑business revenue continued to grow. Meta’s third‑quarter revenue rose 26% year‑over‑year to $64.6 billion, beating analysts’ estimate of $63.37 billion. Earnings per share were $3.83, though analysts noted it is unclear how this figure compares directly with Wall Street’s forecast of $5.75 per share.

In addition to spending and cash‑flow issues, Meta disclosed on Wednesday that it will create a non‑voting Class C common‑stock series to preserve a “founder‑led” governance structure and increase the company’s flexibility to raise capital for future growth.

According to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), if a “California wealth tax” is enacted, CEO Mark Zuckerberg could face billions of dollars in taxes on his Meta holdings and might consider leaving California. The filing noted that the new stock plan is intended to encourage Zuckerberg to stay in the state.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

items.title: 【遠東商銀】RBA立場鷹派，激勵澳幣上漲
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: RBA’s Hawkish Stance Fuels Aussie Dollar Rise
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月獨棟住宅建設大幅下滑及未來建設指標建築許可降至三年半低點，並據多名伊朗官員表示有意拖延與美國談判，試圖削弱美國總統川普在11月期中選舉選情，而且美國公債收益率下滑，削減美元吸引力，週三令美元承壓；此外，路透調查顯示，多數經濟學家預計日本央行(BOJ)在12月上調利率至1.50%及維持每季升息一次的節奏，而且日本政府公布9月進、出口分別較上年同期增長18.9%和16.7%低於預期，但得益於半導體和人工智能(AI)相關產品需求強勁，出口連續十三個月實現增長，貿易逆差則縮窄至5,366億日圓，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月指出，進口成本上升推動日本經濟面臨物價上漲，且即將進入由工資上漲驅動的持續通貨膨脹時期，政府將與BOJ保持密切溝通，雙方在通貨膨脹前景與政策方面無重大分歧，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.39高點下滑。

隨著日本長期公債收益率延續漲勢，正吸引日本資本加劇回流，並據BOJ副總裁冰見野良三表示，燃料和原材料價格上漲推高物價，且全球AI需求旺盛對物價形成上行壓力，認為日本基礎通貨膨脹率已相當接近央行的2%目標，表明BOJ已準備好上調借貸成本，擴大美元兌日圓跌幅至157.82低點，但美國和以色列與伊朗之間的衝突加劇，市場波動性上升及引發對能源供應中斷的擔憂，而且美國原油燃料庫存下降提供額外支持，國際原油價格上漲，限制美元走低。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.20-40，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁豪澤昨日表示，貨幣緊縮正在使經濟放緩，但原油價格高企令通貨膨脹惡化，讓其不確定下個月是否需要進一步加息，目前市場預計RBA於11月加息的概率升至約50%，激勵澳幣漲至三周高點，帶動歐元兌美元自1.1211低點上漲。

paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。

Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。
其他貨幣方面，澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁Andrew Hauser在花旗集團一場會議上表示，通膨前景「明顯惡化」，帶動澳幣走強。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.

items.title: 英國財政預算案前夕 英鎊對歐元避險成本創5個月新高
items.title_en: Britain's Budget Looms as GBP/EUR Hedging Cost Hits Five-Month High
paras: 隨著交易員針對下周即將公布的英國財政預算案進行布局，英鎊對歐元匯率波動的避險成本已攀升至5個月來的新高。
其中，涵蓋預算案公布日期的歐元對英鎊一周隱含波動率一度升至 4.88%，創下 5 月以來的最高水準。一周與三周波動率之間的價差大幅偏向短天期，顯示出強烈的事件風險溢價，創下5個月來最大差距，儘管三周期的選擇權同時涵蓋了英國央行與歐洲央行的利率決策會議。
目前市場投資人高度聚焦於英國的財政前景，以及財政大臣希利(John Healey)將如何平衡政府收支。由於英國今年上半年的政府借款高於預期，推升國家債務總額突破 3 兆英鎊(約 4 兆美元)。
選擇權市場的情緒(反映於風險逆轉指標)顯示，儘管交易員支付更高代價以防範預算案公布期間的大幅波動，但市場仍預期未來一周英鎊對歐元將呈現溫和走強。此外，交易員過去常利用歐元來表達英國特有的風險，但此次歐元自身也已面臨財政與地緣政治壓力。
集保結算公司(DTCC)數據顯示，交易員已透過延伸至預算案公布日後的合約防範英鎊對美元下跌，但對歐元的布局則相對分歧。
在預算案存在不確定性的同時，英國 9 月通膨率因汽柴油價格飆升而創下 11 個月新高，強化了市場對升息的預期，使英國央行處於3年多來首次升息的軌道上。對於央行而言，關鍵在於財政聲明是否會改變通膨前景。
施羅德投資(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees對此表示：「市場對預算案的期望雖然不高，但任何顯著的財政刺激措施，都可能增加進口通膨變得更加持久的風險，並迫使英國央行進入更長的緊縮周期。」
paras_en: As traders position for next week’s UK fiscal budget announcement, the hedging cost of GBP/EUR volatility has risen to a five‑month peak.

The one‑week implied volatility of EUR/GBP covering the budget release date briefly spiked to 4.88%, the highest since May. The spread between one‑week and three‑week volatilities swung sharply toward the short end, indicating a strong event‑risk premium and the widest gap in five months, even though the three‑week options also encompass both the Bank of England and European Central Bank rate‑setting meetings.

Market participants are now intensely focused on the UK’s fiscal outlook and how Finance Minister John Healey will balance the government’s books. Borrowing in the first half of the year has exceeded expectations, pushing total national debt past £3 trillion (about $4 trillion).

Options‑market sentiment, reflected in the risk‑reversal indicator, shows that although traders are paying higher premiums to guard against large moves during the budget release, the market still expects a modest GBP strength against the euro over the next week. Historically, traders have used the euro to express UK‑specific risk, but this time the euro itself is also under fiscal and geopolitical pressure.

Data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) indicate that traders have extended contracts beyond the budget announcement date to hedge against a GBP fall versus the dollar, while positioning on the euro remains more mixed.

Amid budget uncertainty, September UK inflation hit an 11‑month high driven by soaring petrol and diesel prices, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and putting the Bank of England on track for its first increase in over three years. For the central bank, the key question is whether the fiscal statement will alter the inflation outlook.

David Rees, global head of economics at Schroders, said: “Market expectations for the budget are modest, but any significant fiscal stimulus could make imported inflation more persistent and force the Bank of England into a longer tightening cycle.”

三大法人今日合計買超台股 5.68 億元。其中外資及陸資終結連續 10 個交易日的賣超，回頭買超 9.6 億元；投信則連續 9 個交易日力挺，加碼買超 129.19 億元；自營商仍站賣方調節，賣超 133.11 億元。外資由賣轉買並同步於匯市匯入，帶動股匯雙雙止跌回升。
觀察後續市場演變，匯銀人士分析，外資今日展現強烈回流意願，帶動新台幣一舉化解連續重貶破底的危機。目前新台幣收盤重回 32.50 元大關上方，短線重點將觀察外資買超台股的續航力道以及美國通膨數據、聯準會利率政策動向。若熱錢持續湧入，新台幣不排除進一步向 32.30 元關卡挑戰。
整體而言，投資人宜密切關注美股財報週表現、外資於現期貨市場與外匯市場的資金配置幅度，以及亞幣整體的相對強弱，作為後續投資佈局與資產風險控管的依據。
paras_en: Breaking a streak of four consecutive declines, the New Taiwan Dollar in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market opened lower against the US dollar this morning (21st) but turned higher, falling to a low of 8.7 points before rallying up to 1.88 NTD in the afternoon. The intraday high‑low spread reached 2.75 NTD, reflecting fierce buying‑selling battles, and the session closed at 32.488 NTD, up 1.29 NTD. Taipei’s FX turnover was US$20.59 billion, showing unusually active trading as hot money flows and hedging demand intertwined.

The NT$ briefly slipped to a new intraday low of 32.704 NTD in the early session due to foreign‑capital outflows, but a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, foreign inflows and related adjustments drove a sharp afternoon reversal, ending the day with a strong 1.29 NTD rise to close at 32.488 NTD, ending the four‑day losing streak. Looking at the day’s price action, the opening price was 32.630 NTD, the intraday high was 32.429 NTD, the low was 32.704 NTD, and the high‑low spread was 2.75 NTD.

From the international market and overall environment, US tech earnings and a rally in semiconductor stocks lifted the Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor indices, which in turn boosted major Asian equity markets and currencies. Major Asian currencies such as the yen and won generally appreciated against the dollar, attracting international capital back to Asian emerging markets. The one‑sided selling pressure in the FX market eased markedly, prompting a flood of bullish buying in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market.

On the equity side, according to the latest statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the market was driven by heavyweight electronic stocks, surging 594.84 points to finish at 46,887.77 points with a turnover of NT$8,331.91 billion.

The three major institutional investors bought a net NT$5.68 billion of Taiwanese stocks today. Foreign and mainland investors ended a ten‑day streak of net selling, turning to a net purchase of NT$9.6 billion; investment trusts continued a nine‑day buying streak, adding a net NT$129.19 billion; proprietary traders remained net sellers with a net sale of NT$133.11 billion. The shift of foreign investors from selling to buying, coupled with FX inflows, helped both stocks and the NT$ rebound.

Looking ahead, FX analysts note that foreign investors showed a strong willingness to return today, helping the NT$ quickly resolve the crisis of consecutive sharp depreciations. The NT$ now closed back above the 32.50 NTD threshold; short‑term focus will be on the sustainability of foreign buying in equities, US inflation data, and Fed rate policy. If hot money continues to flow in, the NT$ could further test the 32.30 NTD level.

Overall, investors should closely monitor US earnings reports, the scale of foreign capital allocation in futures and FX markets, and the relative strength of Asian currencies as bases for future investment positioning and asset‑risk management.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

市場權衡美國總統川普簽署豁免對俄羅斯能源出口的部分制裁和關稅，另一方面針對沙烏地阿拉伯與也門的襲擊事件使中東能源供應中斷的擔憂持續存在，導致原油價格重拾漲勢，而且法國騷亂推高對避險資產的需求，提供美元支撐，但路透/益普索民意調查顯示，美國總統川普的支持率跌至31%歷史新低，令美元受阻；此外，被視為日本首相高市早苗再通貨膨脹派盟友之一的經濟財政大臣城內實週二表示，希望出席日本央行(BOJ)本月的政策會議，但尊重BOJ的獨立性，並據四位熟悉BOJ決策思路的消息人士稱，鑒於BOJ上個月剛剛加息，預計其在10月30日結束的政策會議將維持利率不變，但油價上漲給經濟帶來的物價壓力持續比預期更久，BOJ可能在會議結束後發布的季度報告中，上調對下一財政年的通貨膨脹預估，為最早於12月再升息留下空間，而且日本二十年期公債標售投標倍數達5.84倍創紀錄新高，強烈表明觀望資金開始回流，與歐洲政治和財政局勢相比，日本公債開始顯現相對避險資產的吸引力，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.59高點下挫。

隨後美國商務部公布9月建築許可減0.2%至年率為140萬戶高於預期，但房屋開工驟降5.2%至經季節調整年率達122.1萬戶，並據全美住宅建築商協會(NAHB)調查9月成屋待完成銷售指數暴跌7.3%至66.0，創該指數2001年開始編制以來最低，突顯中東衝突推高抵押貸款利率和建築材料價格，打擊房地產市場，衝擊美元兌日圓跌至157.81低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.30-50，支撐於157.40-60。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲央行(RBA)金融市場主管強調本月28日公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)重要性，市場預估核心CPI較前季升1.0%，並較上年同期維持3.6%，遠高於RBA的2%至3%目標，同日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)可能宣布今年第三次加息，升息25個基點的概率達89%，昨日支撐澳幣和紐元，而且中東衝突推升能源價格，德國9月生產者物價指數(PPI)較前月升1.9%高於預期及較去年同期漲6.7%創三年半新高，推動歐元兌美元自1.1204低點上漲。
據德國經濟研究所ZEW表示，能源價格高企抑制民間消費與投資，10月德國投資者信心指數降至28.1超過預期，但法國動盪局勢緩和及美國數據疲弱，扶助歐元兌美元回升至1.1260高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1270-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國公布截至8月的三個月，不含獎金平均薪資較上年同期增3.7%及失業率降至去年中以來最低4.7%，強化英國央行(BOE)於下月會議上調利率至4%的預期，支撐英鎊兌美元穩守1.3296低點。隨著BOE貨幣政策委員會(MPC)委員格林稱，伊朗戰爭引發能源價格衝擊，導致更廣泛通貨膨脹回升風險高於BOE預期，重申利率應上調的觀點，提振英鎊兌美元1.3409高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3330-50，阻力於1.3430-50。

The market is weighing U.S. President Trump’s signing of exemptions to some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy exports, while concerns over Middle‑East energy supply disruptions persist after Saudi‑Yemen attacks, pushing oil prices back up. French unrest is also raising demand for safe‑haven assets, supporting the dollar, but a Reuters/Ipsos poll shows Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a historic low of 31%, weighing on the greenback. In addition, Economy and Finance Minister Shiroi, seen as an ally of Prime Minister Kishida’s inflation‑focused camp, said on Tuesday he hopes to attend the Bank of Japan’s policy meeting this month but will respect the BOJ’s independence. According to four sources familiar with BOJ decision‑making, given the BOJ’s recent rate hike last month, the policy meeting ending on Oct. 30 is expected to keep rates unchanged, but higher oil prices are sustaining price pressures longer than expected, so the BOJ may raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the post‑meeting quarterly report, leaving room for a possible December rate hike. Moreover, the 20‑year Japanese government bond auction saw a record‑high bid‑to‑cover ratio of 5.84, indicating that cautious funds are returning, and compared with Europe’s political and fiscal situation, Japanese bonds are showing relative safe‑haven appeal, bolstering the yen and pulling the USD/JPY down from its 158.59 peak.

Following that, the U.S. Commerce Department reported September building permits fell 0.2% to an annualized 1.4 million, above expectations, while housing starts plunged 5.2% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.221 million. The NAHB’s September new‑home sales index dropped 7.3% to 66.0, the lowest since the index began in 2001, highlighting how Middle‑East conflict‑driven mortgage rates and construction material costs are hurting the housing market and pushing the USD/JPY down to a low of 157.81. Today’s USD/JPY resistance is projected at 158.30‑50 with support at 157.40‑60.
EUR/USD

The RBA’s head of market operations stressed the importance of the Q3 CPI release on the 28th; the market expects core CPI to rise 1.0% from the previous quarter and to stay at 3.6% year‑on‑year, well above the RBA’s 2‑3% target. On the same day, the RBNZ may announce its third rate hike of the year, with an 89% chance of a 25‑basis‑point increase, which supported the Aussie and Kiwi dollars yesterday. Meanwhile, the Middle‑East conflict is lifting energy prices, and Germany’s September PPI rose 1.9% month‑on‑month, beating expectations and up 6.7% year‑on‑year – a three‑and‑a‑half‑year high – pushing the euro up from its 1.1204 low.

According to Germany’s ZEW institute, high energy prices are suppressing private consumption and investment; the October German investor confidence index fell to 28.1, worse than expected. However, easing turmoil in France and weak U.S. data are helping the euro rebound to a high of 1.1260. Today’s euro support is seen at 1.1190‑1.1210 with resistance at 1.1270‑1.1290.
GBP/USD

On Tuesday the UK reported that average earnings (excluding bonuses) for the three months to August rose 3.7% year‑on‑year and the unemployment rate fell to 4.7%, the lowest since mid‑last year, strengthening expectations that the Bank of England will raise rates to 4% at next month’s meeting and keeping the pound near its 1.3296 low against the dollar. BOE MPC member Green warned that the Iran war is driving up energy prices, raising broader inflation risks higher than the BOE anticipated, and reiterated that rates should be raised, lifting the pound to a 1.3409 high. Today’s pound support is projected at 1.3330‑1.3350 with resistance at 1.3430‑1.3450.
